-- FNV-1a 32-bit hash
function fnv1a_32(str)
    local hash = 0x811c9dc5
    for i = 1, #str do
        hash = bit32.bxor(hash, string.byte(str, i))
        hash = bit32.band(hash * 0x01000193, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    end
    return hash
end

-- Make a clean “reduced” slug: lowercase, dashes for spaces, strip punctuation (incl. '/').
local function toReducedSlug(name)
  local s = (name or ""):lower()
  s = s:gsub("%s+", "-")         -- spaces -> dash
  s = s:gsub("[^%w%-]", "")      -- strip everything that's not [a-z0-9-]
  s = s:gsub("%-+", "-")         -- collapse repeats
  return s
end

function sendAnalytics(eventName, player, extra)
  if version=="dev" then return end
  local sid = player and player.steam_id or ""
  -- anonymize the player's steam id
  local anonID = sid ~= "" and fnv1a_32("cruxisfine" .. sid) or 0
  local payload = {
    mod       = "Riftbound : LGS Table",
    version   = version,
    event     = eventName,
    timestamp = os.time(),
    session   = analyticsSessionID,
    player    = anonID,
    extra     = extra or {},
  }
  local body    = JSON.encode(payload)
  local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }

  WebRequest.custom(
    analyticsURL,      -- url
    "POST",            -- method
    true,              -- download response body
    body,              -- data to send
    headers,           -- headers
    function(req)      -- callback
      if req.is_error or req.response_code >= 400 then
        print(string.format(
          "Analytics ➜ ERROR %s: %s",
          tostring(req.response_code),
          req.error or req.text
        ))
      end
    end
  )
end

local function sanitizePrivateData(data)
  local out = {}

  for k, v in pairs(data or {}) do
    if k == "card_id" or k == "unitcard" or k == "gearcard" then
      -- strip
    else
      out[k] = v
    end
  end

  return out
end

local function getOrCreateNotebook(title, color)
  local tabs = getNotebookTabs()

  for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
    if t.title == title then
      return t
    end
  end

  local tab = {
    title = title,
    body  = "Replay v1",
    color = color or "Grey"
  }
  addNotebookTab(tab)
  return tab
end

local function appendToNotebook(title, line, color)
  local tab = getOrCreateNotebook(title, "Grey")

  if tab.body ~= "" then
    tab.body = tab.body .. "\n"
  end
  tab.body = tab.body .. line

  editNotebookTab(tab)
end

ReplayLog = {
  seq = 0,
  startTime = os.clock()
}

local function nowMs()
  return math.floor((os.clock() - ReplayLog.startTime) * 1000)
end

local function encodeEvent(evt)
  return JSON.encode(evt)
end

replay_log_enabled = false

function ReplayLog.log(eventType, playerColor, data, visibility)
  if not replay_log_enabled then return end
  ReplayLog.seq = ReplayLog.seq + 1

  local evt = {
    meta = {
      t = nowMs(),
      seq = ReplayLog.seq,
      v = 1,
    },
    type = eventType,
    player = playerColor,
    visibility = visibility or "public",
    data = data or {}
  }

  local encoded = encodeEvent(evt)

  appendToNotebook("Game Log (Global)", encoded, "Grey")

  print(eventType)

  local colors_to_iterate = isFourPlayerMode() and {"Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple"} or {"Red", "Blue"}

  for _, color in ipairs(colors_to_iterate) do
    local title = "Game Log (" .. color .. ")"

    if evt.visibility == "public" then
      appendToNotebook(title, encoded, color)

    elseif color == playerColor then
      appendToNotebook(title, encoded, color)

    else
      local sanitizedEvt = {
        meta = evt.meta,
        type = evt.type,
        player = evt.player,
        visibility = "private_sanitized",
        data = sanitizePrivateData(evt.data)
      }

      appendToNotebook(title, encodeEvent(sanitizedEvt), color)
    end
  end
end

local function normalizePlaymatImageUrl(url)
  local s = tostring(url or ""):lower()
  s = s:gsub("%s+", "")
  s = s:gsub("/+$", "")
  return s
end

local function detectPlaymatModeFromObject(mat)
  if not mat then return nil end
  local custom = mat.getCustomObject() or {}
  local image = normalizePlaymatImageUrl(custom.image)
  if image == "" then return nil end

  local smallUrl = normalizePlaymatImageUrl(playmat_size_url.small)
  local bigUrl = normalizePlaymatImageUrl(playmat_size_url.big)
  if image == smallUrl then return "small" end
  if image == bigUrl then return "big" end

  if image:find("13464931927252746682", 1, true) then return "small" end
  if image:find("16392939827982872150", 1, true) then return "big" end
  return nil
end

function syncPlaymatModesFromCurrentArt()
  for _, color in ipairs({"Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple"}) do
    local guid = playmats[color]
    local mat = guid and getObjectFromGUID(guid) or nil
    if mat then
      local detected = detectPlaymatModeFromObject(mat)
      if detected then
        playmat_size_by_color[color] = detected
      end
      mat.setSnapPoints({})
      setMatSnapPoints(mat)
    end
  end
end

    end
  end
  return nil

local function getPlaymatModeByColor(color)

  return playmat_size_by_color[color] or "small"
end

local function getDeckPositionsForMat(mat)
  if not mat then return deck_position_by_mode.small end
  local color = getPlaymatColorByGuid(mat.getGUID())
  local mode = getPlaymatModeByColor(color)
  return deck_position_by_mode[mode] or deck_position_by_mode.small
end

local function getDeckPositionForMat(mat, position)
  local positions = getDeckPositionsForMat(mat)
  return positions[position]
end

local function getDeckPositionForColor(player_color, position)
  local mode = getPlaymatModeByColor(player_color)
  local positions = deck_position_by_mode[mode] or deck_position_by_mode.small
  return positions[position]
end


function getSnapPosition (mat, position)
  basic_position = getDeckPositionForMat(mat, position)
  if not basic_position then return nil end
  scale = mat.getScale()
  scaleFactor = scale.z / scale.x

  return {basic_position[1] * scaleFactor, basic_position[2], basic_position[3]}
end

function glimpse1(playerColor)

  local deck = findPlayerDeckByName(playerColor, "main")
  if not deck then return end

  -- 1) Take the top card (index=0) off the deck,
  --    dropping it just above the deck so it spawns in view
  local spawnPos = deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0)
  local card = deck.takeObject({
    index    = 0,
    position = spawnPos,
    smooth   = false
  })

  if card then
    Wait.condition(function()
      -- send it to the player’s hand (hand #2 here),
      -- then register it with the Encoder
      card.deal(1, playerColor, 2)
      Encoder.call("APIencodeObject", { obj = card })
      Encoder.call("APIobjEnableProp", { obj = card, propID = "πGlimpse" })

    end, function()
      return not card.spawning
    end)
  end
end

function reveal1(playerColor)

  local deck = findPlayerDeckByName(playerColor, "main")
  if not deck then return end

  local mat = getPlaymat(playerColor)

  -- 1) Take the top card (index=0) off the deck,
  --    dropping it just above the deck so it spawns in view
  local spawnPos = deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0)
  local card = deck.takeObject({
    index    = 0,
    position = spawnPos,
    rotation = mat.getRotation(),
    smooth   = false
  })

  if card then
    Wait.condition(function()
      card.use_gravity = false
      card.drag_selectable = true

      revealCards[card.guid] = os.time()
      repositionRevealLine()
    end, function()
      return not card.spawning
    end)
  end
end


revealZoneArrivedCards = {}

function repositionRevealLine()
    local REVEAL_ZONE_GUID = "fad044"
    local REVEAL_ZONE_WIDTH_X = 16
    local REVEAL_FLOAT_Y_OFFSET = 0.1
    local REVEAL_FLOAT_Z_OFFSET = -0.9
    local CARD_WIDTH_X = 2.5    -- world units, tune once

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(REVEAL_ZONE_GUID)
    if not zone then return end

    -- count cards
    local timeSortedRevealCards = {}

    local count = 0
    for guid, timestamp in pairs(revealCards) do
        table.insert(timeSortedRevealCards, {
            guid = guid,
            time = timestamp
        })
        count = count + 1
    end
    if count == 0 then return end

    table.sort(timeSortedRevealCards, function(a, b)
        return a.time < b.time
    end)

    local center = zone.getPosition()
    local idealSpacing = CARD_WIDTH_X
    local maxAllowedSpacing = REVEAL_ZONE_WIDTH_X / math.max(count - 1, 1)
    local spacing = math.min(idealSpacing, maxAllowedSpacing)
    local usedWidth = spacing * math.max(count - 1, 0)
    local startX = center.x - (usedWidth / 2)


    for i, entry in ipairs(timeSortedRevealCards) do
        local card = getObjectFromGUID(entry.guid)
        card.use_gravity = false
        card.drag_selectable = true

        card.setPositionSmooth({
            startX + i * spacing,
            center.y + REVEAL_FLOAT_Y_OFFSET*i,
            center.z - REVEAL_FLOAT_Z_OFFSET
        }, false, true)

        Wait.condition( function()
          revealZoneArrivedCards[card.guid] = card
        end, function() return not card.isSmoothMoving() end

        )
    end
end

    deck.Transform.posX = position.x
    deck.Transform.posY = playmat.getPosition().y + bounds.size.y + bounds.offset.y + 1
    deck.Transform.posZ = position.z
    deck.Transform.rotY = rotation.y

      deck.Transform.rotY = deck.Transform.rotY + 270
    end

    local spawned = spawnObjectData({data = deck})
    if spawned and player and player.color then

    return spawned

-- Pixelborn-style deck decode for TTS (base64 + '$' delimited card codes)

local b64chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

local function base64_decode(data)
    data = (data or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    local t = {}
    local bit = bit32

    local function val(c)
        local i = b64chars:find(c, 1, true)
        return i and (i - 1) or nil
    end

    local buffer = 0
    local bits = 0

    for i = 1, #data do
        local c = data:sub(i, i)
        if c ~= "=" then
            local v = val(c)
            if v == nil then
                error("Invalid base64 character: " .. tostring(c))
            end

            buffer = bit.lshift(buffer, 6) + v
            bits = bits + 6

            while bits >= 8 do
                bits = bits - 8
                local byte = bit.band(bit.rshift(buffer, bits), 0xFF)
                t[#t + 1] = string.char(byte)
            end
        end
    end

    return table.concat(t)
end

local function split_dollar(s)
    local out = {}
    local start = 1
    while true do
        local p = s:find("%$", start)
        if not p then
            out[#out + 1] = s:sub(start)
            break
        end
        out[#out + 1] = s:sub(start, p - 1)
        start = p + 1
    end
    return out
end

local function normalize_code(entry)
    entry = (entry or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if entry == "" then return nil end

    -- DotGG starred cards: SFD-236-STAR -> SFD-236s
    entry = entry:gsub("%-STAR$", "s")

    -- Strip trailing numeric variant ONLY if there is another dash before it
    -- SFD-241-1 -> SFD-241
    -- OGN-274   -> unchanged
    entry = entry:gsub("^(.-%-%d+)%-%d+$", "%1")

    return entry
end



local function count_entries(entries)
    local counts = {}
    local order = {}

    for _, raw in ipairs(entries) do
        local code = normalize_code(raw)
        if code then
            if not counts[code] then
                counts[code] = 1
                order[#order + 1] = code
            else
                counts[code] = counts[code] + 1
            end
        end
    end

    local deck = {}
    for _, code in ipairs(order) do
        deck[#deck + 1] = { cardCode = code, count = counts[code] }
    end
    return deck
end

function DecodePixelbornDeckToTable(code_b64)
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local decoded = base64_decode(code_b64)
        if type(decoded) ~= "string" or decoded == "" then
            error("Invalid base64 decode")
        end

        local parts = split_dollar(decoded)
        if type(parts) ~= "table" or #parts == 0 then
            error("No card entries")
        end

        local mainDeck = count_entries(parts)
        if not mainDeck or #mainDeck == 0 then
            error("No valid cards parsed")
        end

        return mainDeck
    end)

    if not ok then
        return nil
    end

    return result
end

-- Debuggable DotGG decoder.
-- Returns: { { cardCode=..., count=... }, ... } on success, or nil on failure.
-- Requires: JSON.decode, and your normalize_code(entry) function.

function DecodeDotGGDeckToTable(deck_text, debug)
    local ok, result = pcall(function()

        if type(deck_text) ~= "string" or deck_text == "" then
            error("Empty deck text")
        end

        local decoded = JSON.decode(deck_text)

        if type(decoded) ~= "table" then
            error("Invalid JSON (not a table)")
        end

        local boards = decoded.boards

        if type(boards) ~= "table" then
            error("No 'boards' field found")
        end
        if type(boards[1]) ~= "table" then
            error("No boards[1] table found")
        end

        local mainBoard = boards[1]

        -- Count how many entries are in the board, and show a sample
        local n = 0
        local sample = {}
        for k,v in pairs(mainBoard) do
            n = n + 1
            if #sample < 10 then
                sample[#sample+1] = tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v)
            end
        end

        local deck = {}
        local bad = { missingCount = 0, badCount = 0, badCode = 0 }
        local anyStar = false

        for rawCode, rawCount in pairs(mainBoard) do
            local codeBefore = tostring(rawCode)
            local code = normalize_code(rawCode)

            if codeBefore:find("%-STAR$") then
                anyStar = true
            end

            local count = tonumber(rawCount)

            if not code then
                bad.badCode = bad.badCode + 1
            elseif not count then
                bad.missingCount = bad.missingCount + 1
            elseif count <= 0 then
                bad.badCount = bad.badCount + 1
            else
                deck[#deck + 1] = { cardCode = code, count = count }
            end
        end
        if #deck == 0 then
            error("No valid cards parsed from boards[1]")
        end

        return deck
    end)

    if not ok then
        return nil
    end

    return result
end



function importResolvedDeckText(player, deck_text, source)
    if not deck_text or deck_text == "" then
        broadcastToColor("Failed to extract deck code from URL.", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    local analyticdata = {}

    if source then
      analyticdata["source"]=source
    end

    -- Riftbound deck code
    local decoded = DecodeDeckCodeToTables(deck_text)
    if decoded then
        analyticdata["format"] = "Deck Code"
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, analyticdata)
        ReplayLog.log("IMPORT_DECK", player.color,
          { analyticdata = analyticdata, deck_text = deck_text },
          "private")
        if spawnRiftboundDecks(player, decoded.mainDeck, decoded.sideDeck, decoded.chosenChampion) then
            finalizeImport(player)
        end
        return
    end

    -- Pixelborn
    local pixelled = DecodePixelbornDeckToTable(deck_text)
    if pixelled then
        analyticdata["format"] = "Pixelborn Code"
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, analyticdata)
        ReplayLog.log("IMPORT_DECK", player.color,
          { analyticdata = analyticdata, deck_text = deck_text },
          "private")
        if spawnRiftboundDecks(player, pixelled, nil) then
            finalizeImport(player)
        end
        return
    end

    local dotGGed = DecodeDotGGDeckToTable(deck_text)
    if dotGGed then
      analyticdata["format"] = "DotGG Code"
      sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, analyticdata)
      ReplayLog.log("IMPORT_DECK", player.color,
        { analyticdata = analyticdata, deck_text = deck_text },
        "private")
      if spawnRiftboundDecks(player, dotGGed, nil) then
          finalizeImport(player)
      end
      return
    end

    -- TTS ID fallback
    local lib = Riftbound_CardLibrary or Global.getVar("Riftbound_CardLibrary")
    if not lib then
        print("ERROR: Riftbound_CardLibrary not set on Global")
        return
    end

    local ok, ttsMap = pcall(lib.call, "getTTSMap")
    if not ok or not ttsMap then
        print("ERROR: Failed to get TTS map")
        return
    end


    local CardIDs = {}
    local failed = {}

    for id in deck_text:gmatch("%S+") do
        if ttsMap[id] then
            table.insert(CardIDs, { cardCode = ttsMap[id], count = 1 })
        else
            table.insert(failed, id)
        end
    end

    if #failed > 0 then
        broadcastToColor(
            "If you are trying to use Overnumbered cards, use Piltover Archive's DECK CODE.Failed to load card IDs: " .. table.concat(failed, ", "),
            player.color,
            {1,0,0}
        )
    end

    if #CardIDs == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No valid IDs!", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    analyticdata["format"] = "TTS Code"
    sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, analyticdata)
    ReplayLog.log("IMPORT_DECK", player.color,
      { analyticdata = analyticdata, deck_text = deck_text },
      "private")
    if spawnRiftboundDecks(player, CardIDs, nil) then
        finalizeImport(player)
    end
end


function fetchDeckCodeFromURL(site, url, pattern, callback)
    WebRequest.get(url, function(req)
        if req.is_error or not req.text then
            print("[" .. site .. "] Web request failed:", req.error)
            callback(nil)
            return
        end

        if not pattern or pattern == "" then
            callback(req.text)
            return
        end

        local result = req.text:match(pattern)
        if not result then
            print("[" .. site .. "] Pattern not found")
            callback(nil)
            return
        end

        callback(result)
    end)
end

function importRiftboundDeck(player, value, index, deck_text)
    local deck_text = deck_text or trimSpaces(ui_decklist_state[player.steam_id] or "")
    if deck_text == "" then
        broadcastToColor("Paste Deck Code Or TTS Code!", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    -- URL paths (async)
    if deck_text:find("piltoverarchive.com") then
        fetchDeckCodeFromURL("piltover", deck_text, 'href="[^"]-/deckbuilder%?code=([^"&]+)"', function(resolved)
            importResolvedDeckText(player, resolved, "Piltover Archive")
        end)
        return
    end

    if deck_text:find("riftmana.com") then
        fetchDeckCodeFromURL("riftmana", deck_text, '<textarea[^>]*class="deckBuilderDeckCodeTextarea"[^>]*>%s*([A-Z0-9]+)%s*</textarea>', function(resolved)
            importResolvedDeckText(player, resolved, "Riftmana")
        end)
        return
    end

    if deck_text:find("riftbound.gg") then
        local slug = deck_text:match("riftbound%.gg/decks/([^/]+)/?")
        if not slug then return end
        local api_url = "https://api.dotgg.gg/cgfw/getdeck?game=riftbound&slug=" .. slug .. "&mode=boards"
        fetchDeckCodeFromURL("dotGG", api_url, '', function(resolved)
            importResolvedDeckText(player, resolved, "DotGG")
        end)
        return
    end

    -- Non-URL path (sync)
    importResolvedDeckText(player, deck_text, "Direct Paste")
end

local function addInvalidCard(invalidCards, section, cardCode, count)
    invalidCards[#invalidCards + 1] = {
        section = section,
        cardCode = tostring(cardCode or "UNKNOWN"),
        count = tonumber(count) or 0,
    }
end

local function formatInvalidCardSummary(invalidCards, limit)
    local parts = {}
    local maxItems = limit or 6

    for i, entry in ipairs(invalidCards) do
        if i > maxItems then
            break
        end

        local prefix = entry.section and ("[" .. entry.section .. "] ") or ""
        parts[#parts + 1] = prefix .. tostring(entry.count or 0) .. "x " .. tostring(entry.cardCode or "UNKNOWN")
    end

    if #invalidCards > maxItems then
        parts[#parts + 1] = "... +" .. tostring(#invalidCards - maxItems) .. " more"
    end

    return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end

local function reportInvalidCards(player, invalidCards)
    if not invalidCards or #invalidCards == 0 then
        return
    end

    local summary = formatInvalidCardSummary(invalidCards, 6)
    broadcastToColor(
        "Skipped invalid card codes during import: " .. summary,
        player.color,
        {1, 0.45, 0.15}
    )
    print("Skipped invalid card codes during import for " .. tostring(player.color) .. ": " .. summary)
end

local function resolveDeckEntries(cardEntries, section, invalidCards)
    local resolved = {}

    for _, cardEntry in ipairs(cardEntries or {}) do
        local cardID = cardEntry.cardCode
        local count = tonumber(cardEntry.count) or 0

        if cardID and count > 0 then
            local card = getCardData(cardID, true)
            if card then
                resolved[#resolved + 1] = {
                    cardCode = cardID,
                    count = count,
                    card = card,
                    data = parseGMNotes(card.gmNotes),
                }
            else
                addInvalidCard(invalidCards, section, cardID, count)
            end
        end
    end

    return resolved
end

function spawnRiftboundDecks(player, mainCardIDs, sideCardIDs, chosenChampionID)
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player.color])
    if not playmat then
        broadcastToColor("Playmat not found!", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return false
    end

    local mainCards = {}
    local sideboardCards = {}
    local championCards = {}  -- Max 1 card
    local legends = {}
    local runeCards = {}
    local battlefieldCards = {}

    local legendName = nil
    local championSlotFilled = false

    local standardDeckSize = 40
    local invalidCards = {}
    local resolvedMainCardIDs = resolveDeckEntries(mainCardIDs, "main", invalidCards)
    local resolvedSideCardIDs = resolveDeckEntries(sideCardIDs, "side", invalidCards)

    for _, cardEntry in ipairs(resolvedMainCardIDs) do
      -- Capture legend name (first legend wins)
      local data = cardEntry.data or {}
      if data.type=="legend" and data.signature_key and not legendName then
        legendName = data.signature_key:lower()
      end
    end

    local championKeys = championKeys or {}

    for _, cardEntry in ipairs(resolvedMainCardIDs) do
        local cardID = cardEntry.cardCode
        local count = cardEntry.count
        local card = cardEntry.card
        local data = cardEntry.data

        if card then
          for i = 1, count do
            local cardType = data.type and data.type:lower() or ""

            if cardType == "legend" and #legends == 0 then
              table.insert(legends, card)

            elseif cardType == "legend" then
              table.insert(mainCards, card)

            elseif cardType == "rune" then
              table.insert(runeCards, card)

            elseif cardType == "battlefield" then
              table.insert(battlefieldCards, card)

            elseif (#mainCards + #championCards) >= standardDeckSize then
              table.insert(sideboardCards, card)

            elseif
              legendName
              and data.signature_key
              and data.signature_key:lower() == legendName
              and not championKeys[card.name]
              and not (chosenChampionID and chosenChampionID~=cardID)
              and (#mainCards + #championCards) < standardDeckSize
            then
              table.insert(championCards, card)
              championKeys[card.name] = true
            else
              table.insert(mainCards, card)
            end
          end
        end
    end
    if sideCardIDs then
      for _, cardEntry in ipairs(resolvedSideCardIDs) do
          local count = cardEntry.count
          local card = cardEntry.card
          for _ = 1, count do
            table.insert(sideboardCards, card)
          end
      end
    end

    if chosenChampionID and not getCardData(chosenChampionID, true) then
        addInvalidCard(invalidCards, "champion", chosenChampionID, 1)
    end

    reportInvalidCards(player, invalidCards)

    if #mainCards == 0 and #runeCards == 0 and #battlefieldCards == 0 and #sideboardCards == 0 and #championCards == 0 and #legends == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("Deck import failed: no valid cards could be resolved.", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return false
    end

    local mainDeck = nil
    if #mainCards > 0 then
        local mainDeck = spawnDeck("main", mainCards, player, false)
        placeNotShuffledMarker(mainDeck, player)
    end
    if #runeCards > 0 then
        local runeDeck = spawnDeck("rune", runeCards, player, false)
        runeDeck.randomize()
    end
    if #battlefieldCards > 0 then
        spawnDeck("battlefield", battlefieldCards, player, false)
    end
    if #sideboardCards > 0 then
        spawnDeck("sideboard", sideboardCards, player, false)
    end
    if #championCards > 0 then
        local championDeck = spawnDeck("champion", championCards, player, false)
        if #championCards > 1 then
            placeChooseOneMarker(championDeck, player)
        end
    end
    if #legends > 0 then
        spawnDeck("legends", legends, player, false)
    end

    broadcastToColor(
        "Riftbound imported! Main:"..#mainCards.." Side:"..#sideboardCards.." Champ:"..#championCards,
        player.color, {0,0.8,0}
    )

    return true
end

-- CARD LOOKUP: Use standalone library
function getCardData(slug, quiet)
    if not Riftbound_CardLibrary then
        print("ERROR: Riftbound_CardLibrary not found!")
        return nil
    end
    local success, result = pcall(Riftbound_CardLibrary.call, "getTTSParams", { slug = slug })
    if success and result then
        return {
            name = result.name or "Unknown",
            description = result.description or "",
            image = result.image or "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AmphiBlocks/Riftbound-TTS/main/riftbound_jpg/".. slug ..".jpg",
            gmNotes = result.gmNotes or "[]",
            slug = slug
        }
    else
        if not quiet then
          print("Failed to get card: " .. slug .. " | Error: " .. tostring(result))
        end
        return nil
    end
end

-- Parse gmNotes JSON
function parseGMNotes(gmNotes)
    local success, data = pcall(JSON.decode, gmNotes)
    return success and data or {}
end

-- Vector helper

    return { x = v1.x + v2[1], y = v1.y + v2[2], z = v1.z + v2[3] }
end

function getDeck(name, cards, player)
    global_offset = (global_offset % 30) + 1

    local sleeve_mapping = getSleeves(player)

    local sleeve = sleeve_mapping[name] or sleeve_mapping["default"]
    local card_scale = getCardScale(player)

    local deckOffset = global_offset * 1000

    local deck_ids       = {}
    local custom_deck    = {}
    local contained_objs = {}

    local idx = 1
    for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
        local cardstomake = (card.quantity == 0 and 1) or (card.quantity or 1)

        for i = 1, cardstomake do
            local orientation = (card.orientation or ""):lower()
            local frontSide, backSide = nil, nil
            local hasOrientations = (type(card.orientations) == "table" and #card.orientations > 0)
            local isMultiState = false

            if hasOrientations then
                isMultiState = true
                local oppositeNeeded = (orientation == "front") and "back"
                    or (orientation == "back") and "front"
                    or nil

                if oppositeNeeded then
                    for b, alt in ipairs(card.orientations) do
                        if (alt.orientation==nil) or (type(alt.orientation) == "string"
                          and alt.orientation:lower() == oppositeNeeded) then
                            backSide = alt
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local hasTypes = (type(card.types) == "table" and #(card.types) > 0)
            if hasTypes then
              if tableContains(card.types, "regalia") or tableContains(card.types, "champion") then
                sleeve = material_sleeves
              else
                sleeve = main_sleeves
              end
            end

            if orientation == "front" and backSide then
                frontSide = card

            elseif orientation == "back" and backSide then
                -- the user put the back side in their deck so we'll just flip it for them
                frontSide = backSide
                backSide  = card
            end

            if isMultiState then
                local frontKey    = (deckOffset + idx)
                local backKey     = frontKey + 1
                local frontBackKey= backKey + 1
                local frontID     = frontKey * 100
                local backID      = backKey * 100
                local frontBackID = frontBackKey * 100

                table.insert(deck_ids, frontID)


                local frontURL = frontSide.image or card_back
                local backURL  = backSide.image  or card_back

                -- This section is to work around a bug in TTS
                local altBackURL

                if backURL:find("shoutatyourdecks.com/images/") then
                    altBackURL = backURL:gsub("https://[^/]+/images/", "https://api.gatcg.com/cards/images/")
                elseif backURL:find("api.gatcg.com/cards/images/") then
                    altBackURL = backURL:gsub("https://api.gatcg.com/cards/images/", "https://shoutatyourdecks.com/images/")
                else
                    altBackURL = backURL
                end

                custom_deck[tostring(frontKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = frontURL .. "?format="..playformat,
                    BackURL      = sleeve,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = true,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }
                custom_deck[tostring(backKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = altBackURL,
                    BackURL      = sleeve,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = true,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }
                custom_deck[tostring(frontBackKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = frontURL,
                    BackURL      = backURL,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = false,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = false,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }

                table.insert(contained_objs, {
                    GUID = randomGUID(),
                    Name = "CardCustom",
                    Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                    Nickname = frontSide.name or "(NoName)",
                    CardID   = frontID,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    CustomDeck = {
                        [tostring(frontKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(frontKey)]
                    },
                    States = {
                        ["2"] = {
                            GUID = randomGUID(),
                            Name = "CardCustom",
                            Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                            Nickname = backSide.name or "(NoName)",
                            CardID   = backID,
                            HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                            CustomDeck = {
                                [tostring(backKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(backKey)]
                            }
                        },
                        ["3"] = {
                            GUID = randomGUID(),
                            Name = "CardCustom",
                            Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                            Nickname = frontSide.name .. " / " .. backSide.name or "(NoName)",
                            CardID   = frontBackID,
                            HideWhenFaceDown = false,
                            CustomDeck = {
                                [tostring(frontBackKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(frontBackKey)]
                            }
                        }
                    }
                })
                idx = idx + 3
            else
                local singleKey = deckOffset + idx
                local singleID  = singleKey * 100

                table.insert(deck_ids, singleID)

                local faceUrl = card.image or card_back

                custom_deck[tostring(singleKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = faceUrl .. "?format="..playformat,
                    BackURL      = sleeve,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = true,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }

                table.insert(contained_objs, {
                    GUID = randomGUID(),
                    Name = "CardCustom",
                    Description = card.description,
                    GMNotes = card.gmNotes,
                    Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                    Nickname = card.name,
                    CardID   = singleID,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    CustomDeck = {
                        [tostring(singleKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(singleKey)]
                    }
                })
                idx = idx + 1
            end
        end
    end

    if #contained_objs == 1 then
        contained_objs[1].Transform.rotZ = 180
        return contained_objs[1]
    else
        return {
            GUID = randomGUID(),
            Name = "Deck",
            Transform = {
                rotX = 360, rotY = 180, rotZ = 180,
                scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale
            },
            Nickname = name,
            DeckIDs = deck_ids,
            CustomDeck = custom_deck,
            ContainedObjects = contained_objs
        }
    end
end

function placeNotShuffledMarker(obj, player)
  if obj then
    local markerGUID = notshuffledmarkers[player.color]
    local marker = getObjectFromGUID(markerGUID)
    if marker then
      local playmatGUID = playmats[player.color]
      local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmatGUID)

      if playmat then
        local rot = playmat.getRotation()
        marker.setRotation(rot)
        if(rot.y>90) then
          marker.setPosition(obj.getPosition() + Vector(6, 0, 0))
        else
          marker.setPosition(obj.getPosition() + Vector(-6, 0, 0))
        end
      end

      marker.setName("Not Shuffled Marker")
      marker.setVar("ownerColor", player.color)
    end
  end
end

function importDeck(player, value, index)
    local deck_text = ui_decklist_state[player.steam_id]
    deck_text = trimSpaces(deck_text)

    if deck_text == "" then
        broadcastToColor("No Decklist URL provided!", player.color, {255,0,0})
        return
    end

    if deck_text:match("^{") then
      local json = JSON.decode(deck_text)
      if json then
          if json.error == nil then
              SpawnDeckFromJson(json, player, value, index)
              writeResetSnapshotToPlaymat(player.color)
              return
          end
      end
    end

    if importDeckFromURL(deck_text, player, value, index) then
        return
    end    -- deck_text:match("^https?://")

    broadcastToColor("Invalid deck input! Provide a valid JSON decklist or a URL.", player.color, {255,0,0})
end

function importDeckFromURL(deck_url, player, value, index)

  if deck_url ~= nil and deck_url:len() > 0 then
    if deck_url:sub(1, 5) ~= "https" then
      deck_url = "https://" .. deck_url
    end

    -- Silvie
    if deck_url:find("silvie.org") ~= nil or deck_url:find("silv.ie") then
        if deck_url:find("format=json") == nil then
            if deck_url:find("?") == nil then
              deck_url = deck_url .. "?format=json"
            else
              deck_url = deck_url .. "&format=json"
            end
        end
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "silvie.org" })
    elseif deck_url:find("shoutatyourdecks.com") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("/decks/", "/api/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "shoutatyourdecks.com" })
    elseif deck_url:find("silvie.gg") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("silvie.gg/decklist%?deck=", "build.silvie.gg/deck/")
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("silvie.gg/decklist/", "build.silvie.gg/deck/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "silvie.gg" })
    elseif deck_url:find("jsonblob.com") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("jsonblob.com/", "jsonblob.com/api/jsonBlob/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "jsonblob.com" })
    elseif deck_url:find("tcgarchitect.com") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("tcgarchitect.com/grand%-archive/decks/", "api.tcgarchitect.com/tts/grand-archive/deck/")
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("tcgarchitect.com/grand%-archive/tournaments/decklists/", "api.tcgarchitect.com/tts/grand-archive/tournament-deck/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "tcgarchitect.com" })
    elseif deck_url:find("fractalofin.site") ~= nil then
        local event_id, player_id,suffix
        local patterns = {
            { pattern = "/player/(%d+).html#deck_(%d+)", swap = true, suffix=""  }, -- player page
            { pattern = "#deck_(%d+)_(%d+)",             swap = false, suffix="" }, -- card/archetype page
            { pattern = "/%w+/(%d+).html#deck_(%d+)_topcut",    swap = false, suffix="_topcut" },  -- event page
            { pattern = "/%w+/(%d+).html#deck_(%d+)",    swap = false, suffix="" },  -- event page
        }

        for _, entry in ipairs(patterns) do
            local first, second = deck_url:match(entry.pattern)
            if first and second then
                player_id = entry.swap and tonumber(first) or tonumber(second)
                event_id = entry.swap and tonumber(second) or tonumber(first)
                suffix = entry.suffix
                break
            end
        end

        if event_id and player_id then
            deck_url = "https://fractalofin.site/tts/event_" .. event_id .. "/" .. player_id .. suffix .. ".json"
        else
            broadcastToColor("Invalid Fractalofin URL format!", player.color, {255,0,0})
            return
        end
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "fractalofin.site" })
    else
        broadcastToColor("Invalid Decklist URL!", player.color, {255,0,0})
        return false
    end

    WebRequest.get(deck_url, function(req)
      if req.is_error then
        log(req.error)
      else
        json = JSON.decode(req.text)
        if json.error ~= nil then
          log(json.error)
          if json.error == "silvie/bad-request" then
            broadcastToColor("Invalid Silvie.org Decklist!", player.color, {255,0,0})
          else
            broadcastToColor("Unknown Error :(", player.color, {255,0,0})
          end
          return false
        else
          -- Generate Cards
          for deck, cards in pairs(json.cards) do
            if #cards > 0 then
              local obj = spawnDeck(deck, cards, player, index=="import_deck_bag")
              -- temporarily disabled
              placeNotShuffledMarker(obj, player)
            end
          end
          if shouldSpawnExtraDecks then
            spawnDeck("extra", {}, player, true)
          end
          extraDecks = {
              references = {},
              token = {},
              generated = {},
              mastery = {}
          }
          shouldSpawnExtraDecks=false
          local mainDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player.color, "main")
          deckcounts[player.color][2] = math.max(60, #mainDeck.getObjects())
          writeResetSnapshotToPlaymat(player.color)
          shutImportLayout(player)
        end
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
end

function performBanishRoulette(cardsInMemory, targetCard, onDone)
  local cfg = banishAnim or {
    enabled     = true,
    totalTime   = 0.6,
    flashTime   = 0.12,
    perStepMin  = 0.04,
    perStepMax  = 0.12,
    maxCards    = 30,
    colorAll    = {1.0, 0.9, 0.2},  -- yellow
    colorOut    = {1.0, 0.35, 0.35},-- red
    colorTarget = {0.35, 1.0, 0.55} -- green
  }

  if not cfg.enabled or #cardsInMemory <= 1 or #cardsInMemory > cfg.maxCards then
    if onDone then onDone() end
    return
  end

  -- Build elimination order (all non-targets, shuffled)
  local pool = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do if c ~= targetCard then table.insert(pool, c) end end
  for i = #pool, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i); pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i] end

  local flashT  = cfg.flashTime or 0.12
  local steps   = #pool
  local budget  = math.max(0, (cfg.totalTime or 0.6) - flashT)
  local perStep = (steps > 0) and (budget / steps) or 0
  perStep       = math.max(cfg.perStepMin or 0.04, math.min(cfg.perStepMax or 0.12, perStep))
  local keepAll = flashT + steps * perStep + 0.25  -- keep yellow long enough to cover eliminations

  -- Stage A: keep EVERYONE yellow for the whole sequence
  for _, c in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do
    if c and not c.isDestroyed() then c.highlightOn(cfg.colorAll, keepAll) end
  end

  -- Stage B: elimination — flash red then turn OFF each non-target
  Wait.time(function()
    for idx, c in ipairs(pool) do
      Wait.time(function()
        if c and not c.isDestroyed() then
          local pulse = math.max(0.06, perStep * 0.6)
          c.highlightOn(cfg.colorOut, pulse)
          Wait.time(function()
            if c and not c.isDestroyed() then c.highlightOff() end
          end, pulse)
        end
      end, (idx - 1) * perStep)
    end

    -- Stage C: crown the target, then finish
    Wait.time(function()
      if targetCard and not targetCard.isDestroyed() then
        -- If target was kept yellow, overwrite with a short green crown
        targetCard.highlightOn(cfg.colorTarget, 0.8)
      end
      if onDone then onDone() end
    end, steps * perStep + 0.02)

  end, flashT)
end

local function banishCardToZone(color, card)
  local mat = getPlaymat(color)
  if not (mat and card) then return end
  local banishedLocal = getDeckPositionForMat(mat, "banished")
  if not banishedLocal then return end
  local banishPos = mat.positionToWorld(banishedLocal)
  card.setPositionSmooth(banishPos)
  card.setRotationSmooth(card_rotations["left"])
end

-- Process a single queued banish request
local function processNextBanish()
  if isBanishBusy then return end
  if #banishQueue == 0 then return end

  -- lock first to avoid races from multiple callers
  isBanishBusy = true
  local job = table.remove(banishQueue, 1)
  if not job then isBanishBusy = false; return end

  local color = job.color
  local zone  = getRuneZone(color)
  if not zone then isBanishBusy = false; processNextBanish(); return end

  -- if there are stacks, split & re-layout; otherwise skip straight to pick
  local function afterReady()
    local cards = getRuneCards(zone)
    if #cards == 0 then
      isBanishBusy = false
      processNextBanish()
      return
    end
    local target = cards[math.random(#cards)]
    performBanishRoulette(cards, target, function()
      banishCardToZone(color, target)
      isBanishBusy = false
      processNextBanish()
    end)
  end

  if zoneHasDecks(zone) then
    reorganizeMemoryZoneOnly(color, afterReady)
  else
    -- no decks; optionally ensure nothing is still moving
    Wait.condition(afterReady, function()
      for _, c in ipairs(getRuneCards(zone)) do
        if c.isSmoothMoving() then return false end
      end
      return true
    end)
  end
end

deck_guid_cache = deck_guid_cache or {
  Red = {},
  Blue = {},
  Green = {},
  Purple = {}
}

function normalizeDeckName(name_fragment)
  if not name_fragment then return nil end
  return tostring(name_fragment):lower()
end

function cacheDeckGuid(player_color, deck_name, obj)
  local key = normalizeDeckName(deck_name)
  if not key or not deck_guid_cache[player_color] then return end

  if obj and obj.getGUID and (obj.tag == "Deck" or obj.tag == "Card") then
    deck_guid_cache[player_color][key] = obj.getGUID()
  else
    deck_guid_cache[player_color][key] = nil
  end
end

function getCachedDeckByName(player_color, name_fragment)
  local key = normalizeDeckName(name_fragment)
  local cache = deck_guid_cache[player_color]
  if not key or not cache then return nil end

  local guid = cache[key]
  if not guid then return nil end

  local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
  if not obj or (obj.tag ~= "Deck" and obj.tag ~= "Card") then
    cache[key] = nil
    return nil
  end

  local minBound, maxBound = getPlaymatBounds(player_color)
  if not isPointInBounds(obj.getPosition(), minBound, maxBound) then
    cache[key] = nil
    return nil
  end

  return obj
end

function findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, name_fragment)
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player_color])
    if not playmat then return end

    local cached = getCachedDeckByName(player_color, name_fragment)
    if cached then
      return cached
    end

    local minBound, maxBound = getPlaymatBounds(player_color)

    -- Try first by name matching
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local pos = obj.getPosition()
        if obj.tag == "Deck"
        and obj.getName():lower():find(name_fragment:lower())
        and isPointInBounds(pos, minBound, maxBound) then
            cacheDeckGuid(player_color, name_fragment, obj)
            return obj
        end
    end

    -- If no deck with matching name, fallback to position check

    local snap_offset = getSnapPosition(playmat, name_fragment:lower())
    if not snap_offset then return nil end  -- unknown type

    local targetPos = playmat.positionToWorld(snap_offset)

    -- Find closest deck to the expected snap point
    local bestDeck = nil
    local bestDist = 1 -- usually like 0.3ish

    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.tag == "Deck" or obj.tag == "Card" then
            local dist = (obj.getPosition() - targetPos):magnitude()
            if dist < bestDist then
                bestDeck = obj
                bestDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    if bestDeck then
      cacheDeckGuid(player_color, name_fragment, bestDeck)
    end
    return bestDeck
end

function getHomogeneousDeckCount(deck)
  if not deck or deck.tag ~= "Deck" then return nil end

  local objects = deck.getObjects()
  if not objects or #objects == 0 then return nil end

  local firstSlug = nil

  for _, entry in ipairs(objects) do
    local notes = entry.gm_notes or entry.GMNotes
    if not notes or notes == "" then return nil end

    local data = parseGMNotes(notes)
    if not data or not data.slug then return nil end

    if not firstSlug then
      firstSlug = data.slug
    elseif data.slug ~= firstSlug then
      return nil
    end
  end

  return #objects
end

function applyStackCounter(deck)
  if not deck or deck.isDestroyed() then return end
  local enc = Global.getVar("Encoder")
  if not enc then return end

  local count = getHomogeneousDeckCount(deck)

  if count then
    enc.call("APIencodeObject", { obj = deck })
    enc.call("APIobjEnableProp", {
      obj = deck,
      propID = "πCounter"
    })

    enc.call("APIobjSetValueData", {
      obj = deck,
      valueID = "picounter",
      data = { picounter = count }
    })

    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons", { obj = deck })
  else
    enc.call("APIencodeObject", { obj = deck })
    enc.call("APIobjDisableProp", {
      obj = deck,
      propID = "πCounter"
    })
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons", { obj = deck })
  end
end

local function bumpCardSet(out, id, count)
  if not id then return end
  local n = tonumber(count) or 0
  if n <= 0 then return end
  out[id] = (out[id] or 0) + n
end

local function accumulateCardSetFromObject(obj, out)
  if not obj then return end

  if obj.tag == "Deck" then
    for _, entry in ipairs(obj.getObjects() or {}) do
      local notes = entry.gm_notes or entry.GMNotes or ""
      local name = entry.nickname or entry.name or ""
      local id = resetCardIdFromNotesAndName(notes, name)
      bumpCardSet(out, id, 1)
    end
  elseif obj.tag == "Card" then
    local id = resetCardIdFromNotesAndName(obj.getGMNotes(), obj.getName())
    bumpCardSet(out, id, 1)
  end
end

local function accumulateCardSetFromZone(player_color, zone_name, out)
  local minBound, maxBound = getBoundsOfDeckZone(player_color, zone_name)
  if not minBound then return end

  for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if (obj.tag == "Deck" or obj.tag == "Card")
      and isPointInBounds(obj.getPosition(), minBound, maxBound)
    then
      accumulateCardSetFromObject(obj, out)
    end
  end
end

local function copyCardSet(src)
  local out = {}
  for id, count in pairs(src or {}) do
    local n = tonumber(count) or 0
    if n > 0 then
      out[id] = n
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function addCardSetInto(target, addition)
  for id, count in pairs(addition or {}) do
    local n = tonumber(count) or 0
    if n > 0 then
      target[id] = (target[id] or 0) + n
    end
  end
end

local function subtractCardSet(minuend, subtrahend)
  local out = {}
  for id, count in pairs(minuend or {}) do
    local remaining = (tonumber(count) or 0) - (subtrahend and (tonumber(subtrahend[id]) or 0) or 0)
    if remaining > 0 then
      out[id] = remaining
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function isCardSetEmpty(set)
  for _, _ in pairs(set or {}) do
    return false
  end
  return true
end

local function toSpawnCardsFromCardSet(set)
  local cards = {}
  local missing = {}

  for id, count in pairs(set or {}) do
    local n = tonumber(count) or 0
    if n > 0 then
      local card = getCardData(id, true)
      if card then
        card.quantity = n
        table.insert(cards, card)
      else
        table.insert(missing, id)
      end
    end
  end

  if #missing > 0 then
    print("Could not resolve " .. tostring(#missing) .. " cards for GG Go Next reset: " .. table.concat(missing, ", "))
  end

  return cards
end

function makeResetSnapshotForPlayer(player_color)
  local mainSet = {}
  local sideboardSet = {}
  local runeSet = {}
  local championSet = {}

  accumulateCardSetFromZone(player_color, "main", mainSet)
  accumulateCardSetFromZone(player_color, "sideboard", sideboardSet)
  accumulateCardSetFromZone(player_color, "rune", runeSet)
  accumulateCardSetFromZone(player_color, "champion", championSet)

  local mainPool = copyCardSet(mainSet)
  addCardSetInto(mainPool, sideboardSet)

  return {
    version = 1,
    main_pool = mainPool,
    original_sideboard = sideboardSet,
    rune = runeSet,
    champion = championSet
  }
end

local function readResetSnapshotFromPlaymat(player_color)
  local playmat = getPlaymat(player_color)
  if not playmat then return nil end

  local notes = playmat.getGMNotes()
  if not notes or notes == "" then return nil end

  local ok, decoded = pcall(JSON.decode, notes)
  if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return nil end
  return decoded
end

function computeResetDecksFromSnapshot(player_color)
  local snapshot = readResetSnapshotFromPlaymat(player_color)
  if not snapshot then return nil end

  local liveSideboard = {}
  accumulateCardSetFromZone(player_color, "sideboard", liveSideboard)

  local sideboardReference = liveSideboard
  if isCardSetEmpty(sideboardReference) then
    sideboardReference = snapshot.original_sideboard or {}
  end

  local mainSet = subtractCardSet(snapshot.main_pool or {}, sideboardReference)

  return {
    main = toSpawnCardsFromCardSet(mainSet),
    rune = toSpawnCardsFromCardSet(snapshot.rune or {}),
    champion = toSpawnCardsFromCardSet(snapshot.champion or {})
  }
end

function resetToGameStart(player, value, index)
    local player_color = player.color

    local now = os.time()
    if lastResetTimes[player_color] and now - lastResetTimes[player_color] > rebounceProtectionTime then
      sendAnalytics("GG Go Next", player)

    performResetFlourish(player, runeDeck, "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10421432526134290630/67E6A533DC249862B62893D9D9612D85867DC67D/")

    resetPlayerRuneManagement(player_color)
end

function performResetFlourish(player, deck, sleeve_url)
    if not deck or deck.tag ~= "Deck" then return end

    local count = #deck.getObjects()
    if count < 3 then return end

    local center = deck.getPosition()
    local radius = 5
    local fixedCount = 12
    local angleStep = (2 * math.pi) / fixedCount

    local total = math.min(count, 30)
    local cardsToAnimate = total - 2
    local animDuration = 0.5
    local delayPerCard = animDuration / cardsToAnimate

    for i = 1, cardsToAnimate do
        local angle = angleStep * i
        local offset = Vector(math.cos(angle) * radius, 2, math.sin(angle) * radius)
        local delay = (i - 1) * delayPerCard

        Wait.time(function()
            local ghost = spawnObject({
                type = "Card",
                position = center + offset,
                rotation = {0, 0, 180},
                scale = {0.95, 0.95, 0.95},
                sound = false

            })

            if ghost then
                ghost.setCustomObject({
                  face = sleeve_url,
                  back = sleeve_url
                })

                ghost.setLock(true)
                ghost.setName("Flourish")
                ghost.setDescription("")
                ghost.setVar('noencode', true)

                Wait.time(function()
                    ghost.setPositionSmooth(center + Vector(0, 2 + i * 0.1, 0), false, true)
                end, 0.2)

                Wait.time(function()
                    if ghost then ghost.destruct() end
                end, 1.0)
            end
        end, delay)
    end
end

function beginNewTurnProcedure(player, value, index)
  local runezone = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player.color])
  local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player.color])
  if isFourPlayerMode() then
    local battlefieldzonewest = getObjectFromGUID(playerbattlefieldFFAZonesWest[player.color])
    wakeUpThingsInZone(battlefieldzonewest, playmat)
    local battlefieldzoneeast = getObjectFromGUID(playerbattlefieldFFAZonesEast[player.color])
    wakeUpThingsInZone(battlefieldzoneeast, playmat)
    local battlefieldzonecenter = getObjectFromGUID(playerbattlefieldFFAZonesCenter[player.color])
    wakeUpThingsInZone(battlefieldzonecenter, playmat)
  else
    local battlefieldzone = getObjectFromGUID(playerbattlefield1v1zonesWest[player.color])
    wakeUpThingsInZone(battlefieldzone, playmat)
    local battlefieldzone = getObjectFromGUID(playerbattlefield1v1zonesEast[player.color])
    wakeUpThingsInZone(battlefieldzone, playmat)
  end
  local lastrotatingobject = wakeUpEverythingOnPlaymat(player, value, index)

  local runeCard = nil
  local runeCard2 = nil
  local runeCard3 = nil

  -- Detect if this is the player's first turn (rune zone has exactly 1 object, the Rune Deck bag/deck)
  local isplayersfirstturn = runezone and #runezone.getObjects() == 1

  local num_other_players = 0
  local num_other_with_runes = 0

  if isplayersfirstturn then
    for _, color in ipairs({"Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple"}) do
      if color ~= player.color then
        local mainDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(color, "main")
        if mainDeck or Player[color].seated then
          num_other_players = num_other_players + 1
        end
        local rz = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[color])
        if rz then

          local has_rune_card = false
          for _, obj in ipairs(rz.getObjects()) do
            if obj.tag == "Card" then
              has_rune_card = true
              break
            end
          end
          if has_rune_card then
            num_other_with_runes = num_other_with_runes + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  Wait.condition(
    function()

      -- Draw a card unless this is the first player's first turn in a multiplayer game
      -- (skip draw only for the very first player overall)
      if not isFourPlayerMode() or not (isplayersfirstturn and num_other_with_runes == 0) then
        drawOneCard(player, value, index)
      end

      runeCard = channelOneRune(player, value, index, false)
      if not runeCard then return end

      Wait.condition(
        function()
          --repositionAllRunesInZone(player.color)
          runeCard2 = channelOneRune(player, value, index, true)

          Wait.condition(
            function()
              repositionAllRunesInZone(player.color)

              -- Channel a third rune if this is the last player's first turn
              -- (all other existing players have already channeled runes)
              if isplayersfirstturn and num_other_with_runes == num_other_players and num_other_players > 0 then
                runeCard3 = channelOneRune(player, value, index, true)
                Wait.condition(
                  function()
                    repositionAllRunesInZone(player.color)
                  end,
                  function()
                    return runeCard3 == nil or not runeCard3.isSmoothMoving()
                  end
                )
              end
            end,
            function()
              return runeCard2 == nil or not runeCard2.isSmoothMoving()
            end
          )
        end,
        function()
          return runeCard == nil or not runeCard.isSmoothMoving()
        end
      )
    end,
    function()
      return lastrotatingobject == nil or not lastrotatingobject.isSmoothMoving()
    end
  )
end

    player_color = player.color
    local mainDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "main")
    if not mainDeck then
        broadcastToColor("No Main Deck found!", player_color, {1,0,0})

    end

    local deckObjs = mainDeck.getObjects()

function channelOneRune(player, value, index, offset)
    local player_color = player.color
    local targetposition = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player_color]).getPosition()
    local targetrotation = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player_color]).getRotation()
    targetrotation.y=180-targetrotation.y
    if (offset) then
      targetposition.x = targetposition.x + 4
    else
      targetposition.x = targetposition.x - 4
    end

    local runeDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "rune")
    cardTaken = nil

    if runeDeck then
      if runeDeck.tag == "Deck" then

        if not runeDeck then
            broadcastToColor("No Rune Deck found!", player_color, {1,0,0})
            return cardTaken
        end

        local deckObjs = runeDeck.getObjects()
        if #deckObjs == 0 then
            broadcastToColor("Rune Deck empty!", player_color, {1,0,0})
            return cardTaken
        end

        cardTaken = runeDeck.takeObject({
            index = 0,  -- Top card
            position = targetposition,
            flip = true
        })
        return cardTaken
      elseif runeDeck.tag == "Card" then
        runeDeck.setPositionSmooth(targetposition, false, true)
        runeDeck.setRotationSmooth(targetrotation, false, true)
        cardTaken = runeDeck
      end
    end
    return cardTaken
end

function wakeUpOneObject(playmat, obj)
  local rot = obj.getRotation()
  local isFaceDown = rot.z > 90 and rot.z < 270

  local newRot = {
      x = playmat.getRotation().x,
      y = playmat.getRotation().y,
      z = isFaceDown and 180 or 0
  }

  local delta = math.abs(obj.getRotation().y-newRot.y)
  obj.setRotationSmooth(newRot)
  return (delta>45)
end

function wakeUpEverythingOnPlaymat(player, value, index)
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player.color])

              if moving then

            end
        end
    end
    return lastrotatingobject
end

-- Helper: split any Deck in the zone into single cards, laid out in a line
function splitDecksInZone(zone)
    local pos = zone.getPosition()
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.tag == "Deck" then
            local contents = obj.getObjects() or {}
            local n        = #contents
            if n > 0 then
                local spacing = 0.6                       -- distance between cards
                local startX  = pos.x - spacing*(n-1)/2  -- center the line
                for i = 1, n do
                    local x = startX + (i-1)*spacing
                    obj.takeObject({
                        index    = 1,
                        position = { 4*x, pos.y + 2, pos.z+0.5 },
                        smooth   = false
                    })
                end
            end
            obj.destruct()
        end
    end
end

function reserveAndReorganizeMemory(player, value, index)
    -- 1) get the memory zone
    local memZone = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player.color])
    if not memZone then
        log("Memory Zone for " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
        return
    end

    -- 2) split any decks into cards
    splitDecksInZone(memZone)

    -- 3) wait a moment for those new cards to appear
    Wait.time(function()
        local memPos = memZone.getPosition()

        -- 4) gather all cards now in memory
        local memoryCards = {}
        for _, o in ipairs(memZone.getObjects()) do
            if o.tag == "Card" then
                table.insert(memoryCards, o)
            end
        end
        local memCount = #memoryCards

        -- 5) find face-down cards in hand
        local handZone = getObjectFromGUID(playerhandzones[player.color])
        if not handZone then
            log("Hand Zone for " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
            return
        end
        local cardsToMove = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(handZone.getObjects() or {}) do
            if c.tag == "Card" and math.abs(c.getRotation().z) > 90 then
                table.insert(cardsToMove, c)
            end
        end
        local handCount = #cardsToMove

        -- 6) compute total and reorganize existing memory
        local totalCount = memCount + handCount
        reorganizeMemoryForTotal(memoryCards, memPos, totalCount)

        -- 7) if no new cards, we’re done
        if handCount == 0 then
            return
        end

        -- 8) otherwise wait a bit more, then move the new cards in place
        Wait.time(function()
            for i, card in ipairs(cardsToMove) do
                local offset   = memCount + (i - 1)
                local finalPos = getMemoryPosition(memPos, offset, totalCount)

                -- quick mid-air reposition
                local cp = card.getPosition()
                card.setPosition({
                    x = (cp.x + finalPos.x) / 2,
                    y = (cp.y + finalPos.y + 40) / 2,
                    z = (cp.z + finalPos.z) / 2,
                })
                card.setPositionSmooth(finalPos)
            end
        end, 0.5)

    end, 0.2)
end

-- Helper: Reorganize existing memory cards for a future total
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function reorganizeMemoryForTotal(cardsInMemory, memPos, futureTotal)
    if #cardsInMemory == 0 then return end

    local spacingSign = (memPos.z < 0) and 1 or -1

    table.sort(cardsInMemory, function(a, b)
      return a.getPosition().x*spacingSign < b.getPosition().x*spacingSign
    end)

    local baseCount = 7
    local baseSpacing = 3.2
    local ySpacing = 0.05
    local maxWidth = (baseCount - 1) * baseSpacing


    local effectiveSpacing
    if futureTotal <= baseCount then
        effectiveSpacing = baseSpacing * spacingSign
    else
        effectiveSpacing = (maxWidth / (futureTotal - 1)) * spacingSign
    end

    -- same centered layout logic
    local startOffset = (futureTotal - 1) / 2
    local initial = memPos.x - startOffset * effectiveSpacing
    local yPos = memPos.y + 1
    local zPos = memPos.z

    for i, card in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do
        local offset = (i - 1)
        local finalPos = {
            x = initial + offset * effectiveSpacing,
            y = yPos + offset * ySpacing,
            z = zPos
        }
        card.setPositionSmooth(finalPos)
    end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper: Calculate final position for a new card offset
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function getMemoryPosition(memPos, offset, futureTotal)
    local baseCount = 7
    local baseSpacing = 3.2
    local maxWidth = (baseCount - 1) * baseSpacing
    local spacingSign = (memPos.z < 0) and 1 or -1

    local effectiveSpacing
    if futureTotal <= baseCount then
        effectiveSpacing = baseSpacing * spacingSign
    else
        effectiveSpacing = (maxWidth / (futureTotal - 1)) * spacingSign
    end

    local startOffset = (futureTotal - 1) / 2
    local initialX = memPos.x - startOffset * effectiveSpacing
    return {
        x = initialX + offset * effectiveSpacing,
        y = memPos.y + 2,
        z = memPos.z
    }
end

-- Wait until the object is stable, optionally switch to newState, then call thenFn (if provided).
function waitToSwitchState(obj, newState, thenFn)
  if not obj or obj.isDestroyed() then return end

  local function stable()
    return obj and not obj.isDestroyed()
       and not obj.isSmoothMoving()
       and not obj.spawning
  end

  local function afterSettled()
    if thenFn then thenFn() end
  end

  local cur = obj.getStateId()
  if cur == newState then
    -- Already in desired state; just wait for stability
    Wait.condition(afterSettled, stable)
    return
  end

  if cur ~= -1 then
    -- Switch state, then wait for it to finish
    obj.setState(newState)
    Wait.condition(afterSettled, function()
      return stable() and obj.getStateId() == newState
    end)
  else
    -- No alt states; just wait for stability and continue
    Wait.condition(afterSettled, stable)
  end
end


function getLastStateIndex(obj)
  local states = obj.getStates()
  if states ~= nil then
    return #states+1
  end
  return 1
end

    end

    for _, o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
      if o.getName() == "Quick Actions Panel" and o.tag == "Card" then
        local target = o.positionToWorld({-2.7,0,0})
        target.y, pos.y = 0, 0
        if (pos - target):magnitude() < 3.3 then
          handleBottomDeck(obj, player_color)
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end

  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Auto-rename decks dropped in main deck area
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  if obj.tag == "Deck" then
    local minB, maxB = getBoundsOfDeckZone(player_color, "main")
    if minB then
      local pos = obj.getPosition()
      if isPointInBounds(pos, minB, maxB) then
        local name = obj.getName()
        if not name:lower():find("main") then
          obj.setName(name .. "main")
        end
        cacheDeckGuid(player_color, "main", obj)
      end
    end
    return
  end

  -- CARD ONLY FROM HERE
  if obj.tag ~= "Card" then return end

  local data = parseGMNotes(obj.getGMNotes())
  if not data then return end

  local hidden = isCardFaceDown(obj)
  local guid   = obj.guid


--------------------------------------------------
  -- DECKS (snap-based, intent-driven)
  --------------------------------------------------
  local playmat = getPlaymat(player_color)
  if not playmat then return end
  local flatpos = vector(pos.x, 0, pos.z)

  for _, target_deck in ipairs({"main","rune","trash"}) do
    local world = playmat.positionToWorld(getSnapPosition(playmat, target_deck))
    world = vector(world[1], 0, world[3])
    if (flatpos - world):magnitude() < 1.5 then
      ReplayLog.log("CARD_ENTER_DECK", player_color,
        { guid = guid, card_id = hidden, deck=target_deck and nil or data.slug },
        hidden and "private" or "public")
      return
    end
  end
  --------------------------------------------------
  -- BASE (bounds-based, per player color)
  --------------------------------------------------
  playerbase = getObjectFromGUID(playerbases[player_color])
  if playerbase and objectIsInZone(obj, playerbase) then
    ReplayLog.log("CARD_DROPPED_BASE", player_color,
      { guid = guid, card_id = data.slug },
      hidden and "private" or "public")
    return
  end

  local hits = Physics.cast({
    origin       = pos + vector(0,3,0),
    direction    = {0,-1,0},
    max_distance = 5,
    type         = 1, -- ray
  })

  local battlefield_location = nil
  local battlefield_list = isFourPlayerMode() and battlefieldsFFA or battlefields1v1

  for _, hit in pairs(hits) do
    local hitObj = hit.hit_object
    if hitObj and hitObj.tag == "Tile" then
      for location, bf_guid in pairs(battlefield_list) do
        if bf_guid == hitObj.guid then
          battlefield_location = location
        end
      end
    end
  end

  if battlefield_location then
    ReplayLog.log("CARD_DROPPED_BATTLEFIELD", player_color,
      { guid = guid, card_id = data.slug, location = battlefield_location },
      hidden and "private" or "public")
    return
  end


end

function onObjectRotate(rotated_object, spin, flip, player_color, old_spin, old_flip)
    if rotated_object.tag ~= "Card" or rotated_object.getName() == "Quick Actions Panel"  then return end

    local data = parseGMNotes(rotated_object.getGMNotes())

    local isHidden = flip==180
    local isTapped = not ((old_spin > 45) and math.abs(old_spin - 180) > 45)

    if(flip~=old_flip)then
      if(isHidden)then
        ReplayLog.log("CARD_FLIPPED_DOWN", player_color,
          { guid = rotated_object.guid, card_id = data.slug, hidden = isHidden },
          "public")
      else
        ReplayLog.log("CARD_FLIPPED_UP", player_color,
          { guid = rotated_object.guid, card_id = data.slug, hidden = isHidden },
          "public")
      end
    end
    if(spin~=old_spin)then
      ReplayLog.log("CARD_ROTATED", player_color,
        { guid = rotated_object.guid, card_id = data.slug, tapped=isTapped },
        isHidden and "private" or "public")
    end

    local type = data and data.type
    if type ~= "rune" then return end

    local fieldGUID    = playerbases[player_color]
    local runezoneGUID = playerrunezones[player_color]
    if not fieldGUID or not runezoneGUID then return end
    if not objectIsInZone(rotated_object, getObjectFromGUID(runezoneGUID)) then return end

    -- tell the repositioner which rune changed, and what its intended state is
    repositionAllRunesInZone(player_color, rotated_object, isTapped)
end
