function isRotationTapped(rotY, debugLabel)
    if (rotY > 45 and rotY < 135) or (rotY > 225 and rotY < 315) then
      return true
    end
    return false
end

local RUNE_COUNT_COLORS = {
  fury  = { text = "#E26A6A", outline = "#9C3E3E" }, -- soft crimson
  mind  = { text = "#6A8FE2", outline = "#3E5A9C" }, -- muted sapphire
  calm  = { text = "#6FCF9B", outline = "#3E8A63" }, -- gentle jade
  body  = { text = "#E2A36A", outline = "#9C6A3E" }, -- warm amber
  order = { text = "#E2D26A", outline = "#9C8F3E" }, -- pale gold
  chaos = { text = "#B58AE6", outline = "#6E4A9C" }, -- soft violet
}

local RUNE_PILE_ORDER = {
  "color1_untapped","color1_tapped",
  "color2_untapped","color2_tapped",
}

-- tappedRune: the rune that was just rotated (may be nil)
-- tappedState: boolean, true=tapped, false=untapped (only relevant if tappedRune is non-nil)
function repositionAllRunesInZone(player_color, tappedRune, tappedState)
    local runeZone = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player_color])
    if not runeZone then return end

    local allObjects = runeZone.getObjects()

    -- If cached rune deck points at a rune card currently in the zone, clear cache.
    -- This prevents recycling logic from treating a face-up single rune as the rune deck.
    local cachedRuneGuid = nil
    if deck_guid_cache[player_color] then
      cachedRuneGuid = deck_guid_cache[player_color]["rune"]
    end
    if cachedRuneGuid then
      for _, obj in ipairs(allObjects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" and obj.getGUID and obj.getGUID() == cachedRuneGuid then
          local data = parseGMNotes(obj.getGMNotes())
          if data and data.type == "rune" then
            cacheDeckGuid(player_color, "rune", nil)
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end

    -- For preserving pile order
    if not runePileOrder[player_color] then runePileOrder[player_color] = {} end
    local pileMap = runePileOrder[player_color]
    playerRunesByPile[player_color] = {}
    local runesByPile = playerRunesByPile[player_color]


    if (#allObjects<3) then -- just the playmat and one rune, so let's reset the colors
      resetPlayerRuneManagement(player_color)
    end

    -- Categorize runes
    for _, obj in ipairs(allObjects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" then
            local data = parseGMNotes(obj.getGMNotes())
            if data and data.type == "rune" then
                local color_identity = data.color_identity
                local color = normalizeRuneColor(color_identity)
                local colorIdx = getColorIndex(player_color, color)
                if colorIdx > 2 then
                  colorIdx = 2
                end
                local isTapped
                if tappedRune and obj == tappedRune then
                    -- override: trust the state from onObjectRotate
                    isTapped = tappedState and true or false
                else
                    -- fallback: infer from rotation
                    local rotY = obj.getRotation().y
                    isTapped = isRotationTapped(rotY, "rune "..obj.getName())
                end

                local pileKey = "color" .. colorIdx .. (isTapped and "_tapped" or "_untapped")
                runesByPile[pileKey] = runesByPile[pileKey] or {}
                pileMap[pileKey] = pileMap[pileKey] or {}

                -- Update order tracking: if new rune not in list, add it at the end
                local guid = obj.getGUID()
                local found = false
                for _, g in ipairs(pileMap[pileKey]) do
                    if g == guid then found = true break end
                end
                if not found then
                    table.insert(pileMap[pileKey], guid)
                end

                -- Store object reference
                runesByPile[pileKey][guid] = obj
            end
        end
    end

    local zonePos = runeZone.getPosition()
    local zoneRot = runeZone.getRotation()

    local rotationIsFlipped = zoneRot.y>90 and zoneRot.y<270

    local rotationMultiplier = rotationIsFlipped and -1 or 1

    local baseY       = 1.00
    local fanStepX    = -0.75 * rotationMultiplier  -- how much to fan along X
    local fanStepZ    = 0.4 * rotationMultiplier  -- how much to fan along Z
    local heightStep  = 0.08   -- how much higher each step on the positive side

    local runeCounts = {}

    for pileKey, runeDict in pairs(runesByPile) do
    local posOffset = pilePositions[pileKey]
    if posOffset then
        local orderedGUIDs = pileMap[pileKey] or {}
        local runes = {}
        -- Build rune list in proper order, remove invalid GUIDs
        local validGUIDs = {}
        for _, guid in ipairs(orderedGUIDs) do
            local rune = runeDict[guid]
            if rune then
                table.insert(runes, rune)
                table.insert(validGUIDs, guid)  -- still valid
            end
        end
        pileMap[pileKey] = validGUIDs  -- cleanup dead refs

        -- ensure tappedRune goes last
        if tappedRune then
            for i, r in ipairs(runes) do
                if r == tappedRune then
                    table.remove(runes, i)
                    table.insert(runes, r)
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        updateRuneRecycleButtons(player_color, runes)

        local baseX = zonePos.x + posOffset.x * rotationMultiplier
        local baseZ = zonePos.z + posOffset.z * rotationMultiplier

        local n = #runes
        local center = (n + 1) / 2
        local pileIsTapped = (pileKey:match("_tapped") ~= nil)

        for i, rune in ipairs(runes) do
            local idxOffset = (i - center)

            local finalPos = {
                x = baseX + idxOffset * fanStepX,
                y = baseY + i * heightStep,
                z = baseZ + idxOffset * fanStepZ
            }

            rune.setPositionSmooth(finalPos, false, true)

            local yaw = zoneRot.y + (pileIsTapped and 270 or 180)

            rune.setRotation(Vector(zoneRot.x, yaw, zoneRot.z))
        end
    end

    inscriptRuneCounts(player_color)

  end
end

function inscriptRuneCounts(player_color)
    local runeCounts = {}
    local runesByPile = playerRunesByPile[player_color] or {}

    -- compute total runes across all piles
    local totalRunes = 0
    for _, pile in pairs(runesByPile) do
        for _ in pairs(pile) do
            totalRunes = totalRunes + 1
        end
    end

    for _, pileKey in ipairs(RUNE_PILE_ORDER) do
        local colorIdx  = tonumber(pileKey:match("color(%d+)"))
        local colorName = getPlayerRuneColors(player_color)[colorIdx]
        local palette   = RUNE_COUNT_COLORS[colorName]

        local count = 0
        if runesByPile[pileKey] then
            for _ in pairs(runesByPile[pileKey]) do
                count = count + 1
            end
        end

        table.insert(runeCounts, {
            count         = ((count > 0)and(totalRunes > 4)) and count or " ",  -- ← blank instead of 0
            text_color    = palette and palette.text or "#FFFFFF",
            outline_color = palette and palette.outline or "#FFFFFF",
        })
    end

    local playmat = getPlaymat(player_color)
    playmat.call("InscriptRuneCountsRemote", {
        runeCounts = runeCounts,
    })
end

-- Helper: Normalize rune color
function normalizeRuneColor(color_identity)
    if not color_identity then return "unknown" end
    return color_identity:lower():match("^%s*([^,%s]+)") or "unknown"
end

    return #playerColors
end

function handleBottomDeck(droppedObject, player_color)
    repositionAllRunesInZone(player_color)
    local deck_name = "main"

    if droppedObject.tag == "Deck" then
        deck_name = getDeckTypeFromTopCard(droppedObject)
        for _, card in ipairs(droppedObject.getObjects()) do
          local data = parseGMNotes(card.gm_notes)
          if data then
            ReplayLog.log("CARD_RECYCLE", player_color,
              { guid = card.guid, card_id = data.slug },
              "public")

            if data.type == "rune" then
              deck_name = "rune"
            end
          end
        end
    else
        local data = parseGMNotes(droppedObject.getGMNotes())
        if data then
          ReplayLog.log("CARD_RECYCLE", player_color,
            { guid = droppedObject.guid,
              card_id = data.slug},
            "public")
          if data.type == "rune" then
            deck_name = "rune"
          end
        end
    end
    local deck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, deck_name)
    -- If lookup resolves to the same object being recycled, treat as no deck present.
    -- This can happen with single runes in big-mat mode and causes self-jitter.
    if deck and droppedObject and deck.getGUID and droppedObject.getGUID and deck.getGUID() == droppedObject.getGUID() then
        deck = nil
    end
    local recycled_position = nil
    if deck then
        recycled_position = deck.getPosition()
    else
        recycled_position = findPlayerZoneLocationByName(player_color, deck_name)
        broadcastToColor("Cannot find your ".. deck_name .." deck - starting a new one!", player_color, {.8,.8,.8})
    end



    local targetRotation = nil
    if deck then
        targetRotation = deck.getRotation()
    else
        targetRotation = getPlaymat(player_color).getRotation()
        targetRotation.z = 180
    end

    local liftedPos = Vector(recycled_position.x, 4, recycled_position.z)
    local lowerPos = Vector(recycled_position.x, 3, recycled_position.z)

    if deck then
      -- Step 1: Lock and Lift the deck
      deck.setLock(true)
      --deck.interactable=false
      deck.setPositionSmooth(liftedPos, false, true)
    end

    local nm = droppedObject.getName()

    Wait.time(function()
        if droppedObject and droppedObject.tag == "Deck" then
          droppedObject.randomize()
        end
        droppedObject.setRotationSmooth(targetRotation, false, true)
        droppedObject.setPositionSmooth(Vector(recycled_position.x, 2, recycled_position.z), false, true)

        Wait.condition(function()
            Wait.time(function()
              if deck then
                  -- Step 3: Move deck back down
                  deck.setLock(false)
                  deck.setPositionSmooth(recycled_position, true, true)

                  -- Step 4: After short delay, unlock the deck
                  Wait.condition(function()
                      Wait.condition(function()
                          local newDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "main")
                          if newDeck then
                              local name = newDeck.getName()
                              if not name:lower():find("main") then
                                  newDeck.setName(name .. "main")
                              end
                              cacheDeckGuid(player_color, "main", newDeck)
                          end
                      end, function () return not(droppedObject and deck)end)
                  end, function () return not deck.isSmoothMoving() end)
              end
            end, 0.5)
        end, function () return not (droppedObject and droppedObject.isSmoothMoving()) end)
    end, 0.1)
end

function linkToDeckBottom(obj, player_color, alt)
    local cards = {}
    local decks = {}
    local seen = {}

    local function addRecycleCandidate(candidate)
        if not candidate or candidate.isDestroyed() then return end
        if not candidate.getGUID then return end

        local guid = candidate.getGUID()
        if not guid or seen[guid] then return end

        if candidate.tag == "Card" then
            candidate.use_gravity = true
            table.insert(cards, candidate)
            seen[guid] = true
        elseif candidate.tag == "Deck" then
            candidate.use_gravity = true
            table.insert(decks, candidate)
            seen[guid] = true
        end
    end

    -- Collect cards directly
    for guid, _ in pairs(revealCards) do
        addRecycleCandidate(getObjectFromGUID(guid))
    end

    -- Also include anything currently in the peek zone (hand 2 / glimpse zone).
    local glimpseGuid = playerglimpsezones[player_color]
    if glimpseGuid then
        local glimpseZone = getObjectFromGUID(glimpseGuid)
        if glimpseZone and glimpseZone.getObjects then
            local zoneObjects = glimpseZone.getObjects() or {}
            for _, zoneObject in ipairs(zoneObjects) do
                addRecycleCandidate(zoneObject)
            end
        end
    end

    if #cards == 0 and #decks == 0 then
        broadcastToColor(
            "Drop cards here to send them to the bottom of your main deck!",
            player_color,
            {255,0,0}
        )
        return
    end

    -- Clear reveal tracking immediately
    revealCards = {}
    revealZoneArrivedCards = {}

    -- Group them like pressing G (works for 1 or many)
    local grouped = {}
    if #cards > 0 then
      grouped = group(cards)
    end

    local handledGroupedDeck = false
    for _, revealCleanupObject in ipairs(decks) do
      handledGroupedDeck = true
      revealCleanupObject.use_gravity = false
      Wait.frames(function()
          revealCleanupObject.use_gravity = true
          handleBottomDeck(revealCleanupObject, player_color)
      end, 100)
    end

    for _, revealCleanupObject in ipairs(grouped) do
      handledGroupedDeck = true
      revealCleanupObject.use_gravity = false
      Wait.frames(function()
          revealCleanupObject.use_gravity = true
          handleBottomDeck(revealCleanupObject, player_color)
      end, 100)
    end
    if not handledGroupedDeck then
      -- Failed to group Reveal cards, cards are put to bottom individually
      for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
          handleBottomDeck(card, player_color)
      end
    end
end

local function getAllBattlefieldZonesForPlayer(color)

      if z then table.insert(zones, z) end
    end
  end

  add(playerbattlefield1v1zonesWest)

  add(playerbattlefieldFFAZonesWest)
  add(playerbattlefieldFFAZonesEast)
  add(playerbattlefieldFFAZonesCenter)

local function rescaleCardsInLooseZonesForPlayer(player)
  local scale = card_scale_by_player[player.steam_id]
  if not scale then return end

  local minBound, maxBound = getPlaymatBounds(player.color)
  local battlefieldZones = getAllBattlefieldZonesForPlayer(player.color)

  for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "Deck" then
      local pos = obj.getPosition()

      -- On playmat
      if isPointInBounds(pos, minBound, maxBound) then
        setObjectCardScale(obj, scale)
      end

      -- In battlefield zones
      for _, zone in ipairs(battlefieldZones) do
        if objectIsInZone(obj, zone) then
          setObjectCardScale(obj, scale)
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

      end
  end

  -- ---------- helpers ----------
  local function urlencode(s)
    return (tostring(s):gsub("\n", "\r\n"):gsub("([^%w _%-%.~])", function(c)
      return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c))
    end):gsub(" ", "%%20"))
  end

  local function clean(s)
    s = (s or ""):lower()
    s = s:gsub("[%p]", " "):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return s
  end

  -- rank:
  -- 1 = exact match
  -- 2 = exact word match (earlier word wins)
  -- 3 = word startswith (earlier word wins)
  -- 4 = contains (earlier position wins)
  -- else = 100

  local function rankName(name, q)
      local n = clean(name)
      local qn = clean(q)

      if n == qn then
          return 1
      end

      local qlen = #qn

      -- Scan words with positions
      local wordIndex = 0
      for startPos, word in n:gmatch("()(%S+)") do
          wordIndex = wordIndex + 1

          if word == qn then
              -- Rank 2, bias earlier words
              return 2 + wordIndex * 0.001
          end

          if word:sub(1, qlen) == qn then
              -- Rank 3, bias earlier words
              return 3 + wordIndex * 0.001
          end
      end

      -- Contains fallback (plain find, earliest position wins)
      local pos = n:find(qn, 1, true)
      if pos then
          return 4 + pos * 0.001
      end

      return 100
  end

-- reduced tools slug from TITLE (left side of '/', slugified)
local function reducedSlugFromTitle(name)
  name = name or ""
  -- take only the left side before a slash (if any)
  local left = name:match("^(.-)%s*/%s*.+$") or name
  left = left:lower()

  -- handle possessives like "revenant’s" / "revenant's" → "revenants"
  left = left:gsub("['’]s", "s")

  -- drop leftover apostrophes/backticks (straight or curly)
  left = left:gsub("[‘’´`']", "")

  -- spaces → hyphen
  left = left:gsub("%s+", "-")

  -- turn any remaining non-alnum, non-hyphen chars into hyphen
  left = left:gsub("[^%w%-]+", "-")

  -- collapse multiple hyphens and trim edges
  left = left:gsub("%-+", "-"):gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "")

  return left
end

local function spawnFromToolsSlug(slug, player)
    local cardData = getCardData(slug, true)
    if not cardData then
      if player then
        player.broadcast("Could not spawn missing card: " .. tostring(slug), {1,0.3,0.3})
      end
      print("Failed to spawn missing card slug: " .. tostring(slug))
      return false
    end

    local text = JSON.encode(cardData)
    local blob = '{"cards":{"spawn":[' .. text .. ']}}'
    local ok, json = pcall(JSON.decode, blob)
    local locationOverride = player.GetPointerPosition()
    local rotationOverride = {0, player.GetPointerRotation(), 0}
    locationOverride.y = locationOverride.y+1
    if ok and json then
      local deck = Global.call("spawnDeckRemote", { json = json, player = player, locationOverride = locationOverride, rotationOverride = rotationOverride })
      return deck
    end
    if player then
      player.broadcast("Could not spawn card: " .. tostring(slug), {1,0.3,0.3})
    end
    return false
end




function RipBoosterPack(params)
  local collationlib = Riftbound_CollationLibrary or Global.getVar("Riftbound_CollationLibrary")
  if not collationlib then
    local player = Player[params.player_color]
    if player then
      broadcastToColor("Booster collation library is not loaded yet.", player.color, {1, 0.3, 0.3})
    end
    print("ERROR: Riftbound_CollationLibrary not loaded")
    return
  end

  local ok, pack_contents = pcall(collationlib.call, "GeneratePack", params.setcode)
  if not ok or not pack_contents then
    local player = Player[params.player_color]
    if player then
      broadcastToColor("Failed to generate booster pack for " .. tostring(params.setcode), player.color, {1, 0.3, 0.3})
    end
    print("ERROR: GeneratePack failed for " .. tostring(params.setcode) .. " | " .. tostring(pack_contents))
    return
  end

  local spawn_list = {}

  for _, card_id in ipairs(pack_contents) do
    table.insert(spawn_list, getCardData(card_id))
  end

  local blob = {
    cards = {
      spawn = spawn_list
    }
  }

  local player = Player[params.player_color]
  local locationOverride = player.GetPointerPosition()
  local rotationOverride = {180, 180+player.GetPointerRotation(), 0}
  locationOverride.y = locationOverride.y + 1

  Global.call("spawnDeckRemote", {
    json = blob,
    player = player,
    locationOverride = locationOverride,
    rotationOverride = rotationOverride
  })
  params.object.destroy()
end


-- cache of { {slug=..., name=...}, ... }
Riftbound_NameIndex = Riftbound_NameIndex or nil

local function buildRiftboundNameIndex()
    local lib = Riftbound_CardLibrary or Global.getVar("Riftbound_CardLibrary")
    if not lib then
        print("ERROR: Riftbound_CardLibrary not set on Global")
        return false
    end

    local ok, cardMap = pcall(lib.call, "getMap")
    if not ok or not cardMap then
        print("ERROR: getMap() failed on Riftbound_CardLibrary")
        return false
    end

    local index = {}
    for slug, data in pairs(cardMap) do
        table.insert(index, {
            slug = slug,
            name = (data and data.name) or ""
        })
    end

    Riftbound_NameIndex = index
    print("Riftbound name index built with " .. tostring(#index) .. " entries.")
    return true
end

function spawnFromNameFragmentRemote(payload)
  return spawnFromNameFragment(payload.nameFragment, payload.player_color)
end

function spawnFromNameFragment(nameFragment, player_color)
  cardFromSlug = getCardData(nameFragment, true)
  if cardFromSlug then
    Player[player_color].broadcast("Spawning: " .. cardFromSlug.name .. " [" .. nameFragment .. "]", {0.6,1,0.6})
    return spawnFromToolsSlug(nameFragment, Player[player_color])
  end
  if not Riftbound_NameIndex then
      if not buildRiftboundNameIndex() then
          Player[player_color].broadcast("Spawn not ready (library error).", {1,0.3,0.3})
          return false
      end
  end

  local initialEntry = {name="NA"}
  local bestEntry = initialEntry
  local bestRank = rankName(initialEntry.name, nameFragment)


  for _, entry in ipairs(Riftbound_NameIndex) do
      local name = entry.name or ""
      if name ~= "" then
          local r = rankName(name, nameFragment)
          if not bestRank or r < bestRank or (r == bestRank and string.len(name) < string.len(bestEntry.name)) then
              bestRank = r
              bestEntry = entry
          end
      end
  end

  if bestEntry == initialEntry then
      Player[player_color].broadcast("No results for: " .. nameFragment, {1,0.9,0})
      return false
  end

  local slug = bestEntry.slug
  local name = bestEntry.name or slug

  Player[player_color].broadcast("Spawning: " .. name .. " [" .. slug .. "]", {0.6,1,0.6})
  local spawned_object = spawnFromToolsSlug(slug, Player[player_color])
  if spawned_object then
    ReplayLog.log("CARD_SPAWNED", player_color,
      { guid = spawned_object.guid,
        card_id = slug },
      "public")
    local menu_provider = Riftbound_CardMenu or Global.getVar("Riftbound_CardMenu")
    Wait.condition(
      function () menu_provider.call("init_card", spawned_object) end,
      function() return not spawned_object.spawning end
    )
  end
  return spawned_object
end

function tutorFromDeckByNameFragment(nameFragment, player)
    local deck = findPlayerDeckByName(player.color, "main")
    if not deck or deck.tag ~= "Deck" then
        player.broadcast("No main deck found.", {1,0.4,0.4})
        return false
    end

    local objects = deck.getObjects()
    if not objects or #objects == 0 then
        player.broadcast("Your deck is empty.", {1,0.4,0.4})
        return false
    end

    local bestIdx = nil
    local bestRank = nil
    local bestName = nil

    for i, entry in ipairs(objects) do
        local name = entry.nickname or entry.name or ""
        if name ~= "" then
            local r = rankName(name, nameFragment)
            if not bestRank or r < bestRank or (r == bestRank and #name < #bestName) then
                bestRank = r
                bestIdx = i
                bestName = name
            end
        end
    end

    if not bestIdx then
        player.broadcast("No match in deck for: " .. nameFragment, {1,0.9,0})
        return false
    end

    local rotationTarget = player.GetPointerRotation()

    -- Pull the card (visibly from deck)
    local taken = deck.takeObject({
        index    = bestIdx - 1, -- TTS uses 0-based indexing
        position = deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2.0, 0), -- lift from deck first
        rotation = {180, rotationTarget+180, 0},
        smooth   = true,
    })

    if not taken then
        player.broadcast("Failed to tutor card.", {1,0.3,0.3})
        return false
    end

    -- Immediately hide information
    --taken.setRotation({0, 180, 0}) -- face-down
    taken.setVelocity({0,0,0})
    taken.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})

    -- Move to cursor after a short moment (keeps visual continuity)
    Wait.frames(function()
        if not taken then return end
        taken.setPositionSmooth(player.getPointerPosition() + Vector(0, 1.5, 0))
    end, 5)

    -- Private confirmation
    player.broadcast(
        "Tutored a card to your cursor.",
        {0.6, 1, 0.6}
    )

    -- Public anonymized broadcast
    for _, p in pairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if p.color ~= player.color then
            p.broadcast(
                player.steam_name .. " tutored a card.",
                {0.8, 0.8, 0.8}
            )
        end
    end

    return taken
end

function onChat(message, player)
    local m = (message or ""):lower()

    if m:sub(1,6) == "spawn " then
        local query = message:sub(7):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if query ~= "" and getPlaymat(player.color) then
            spawnFromNameFragment(query, player.color)
        end
        return false
    end

    if m:sub(1,6) == "tutor " then
        local query = message:sub(7):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if query == "" then
            player.broadcast("Usage: tutor <card name>", {1,0.9,0})
            return false
        end
        tutorFromDeckByNameFragment(query, player)
        return false
    end
end

    ["Shield 3"] = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10446144312172833824/B94544E4AE0179C8862493573ED09B0F7C8B9B70/",
}

status_token_modes_by_number = {}
status_token_numbers_by_mode = {}
num_token_types = 0

current_mode = "Mighty"
current_mode_number = 1

function findKeyByValue(table, value)
    for key, val in pairs(table) do
        if val == value then
            return key
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function onLoad()
    status_token_modes_by_number = {}
    status_token_numbers_by_mode = {}
    num_token_types = 0
    for mode, _ in pairs(status_token_modes) do
        self.addContextMenuItem("Switch to " .. mode, function() setTokenImage(mode) end)
        num_token_types = num_token_types + 1
        status_token_modes_by_number[num_token_types] = mode
        status_token_numbers_by_mode[mode] = num_token_types
    end
    self.addTag("StatusToken")
end

function setTokenImage(mode)
    local custom = self.getCustomObject()
    custom.image = status_token_modes[mode]
    self.setCustomObject(custom)
    self.setName(mode .. " Token")
    self.reload()
    current_mode = mode
    current_mode_number = status_token_numbers_by_mode[mode]
end

function onNumberTyped(player_color, number)
  if (number==0) then
      number = (current_mode_number % num_token_types)+1
  end
  setTokenImage(status_token_modes_by_number[number])
  return true
end

function getCorrectRotation()
  local sideOfTable = self.getPosition().z > 0
  return sideOfTable and {0,0,0} or {0,180,0}
end

function onDrop(color)
    self.setRotationSmooth(getCorrectRotation(), false, true)
end

function onRotate(spin, flip, player_color, old_spin, old_flip)
  local tokenPos = self.getPosition()

  local closest, bestDist = nil, 2.0  -- only within 1 unit
  for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if obj.tag == "Card" and not obj.hasTag("StatusToken") then
      local d = (obj.getPosition() - tokenPos):magnitude()
      if d < bestDist then
        closest, bestDist = obj, d
      end
    end
  end

  if closest then
    local r = closest.getRotation()
    local sideOfTable = self.getPosition().z > 0
    if sideOfTable then
      r.y = (r.y + spin) % 360
    else
      r.y = (r.y - spin) % 360
    end
    closest.setRotationSmooth(r, false, true)
  end

  Wait.time(function()
    self.setRotationSmooth(getCorrectRotation(), false, true)
  end, 0.1)
end

local PACK_SET_CONFIG = {
  SFD = {
    label = "SFD",
    image = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14410242526919890640/D7B6EB271552D25B8718DEB4E05F84577822AB00/",
  },
  OGN = {
    label = "OGN",
    image = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/18145712918562890733/12DCF9231FFDEF5ED47C92AC8E18B8AD48220080/",
  },
  UNL = {
    label = "UNL",
    image = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/12817711439876771065/1D7EBB383E7B5E6376302E425E3E516E18E990E3/",
  },
}

local current_setcode = "UNL"
local PACK_STATE_KEY = "rb_pack_set"

local function parseGMNotesSafe(raw)
  if not raw or raw == "" then return {} end
  local ok, parsed = pcall(JSON.decode, raw)
  if ok and type(parsed) == "table" then
    return parsed
  end
  return {}
end

local function readSetcodeFromGMNotes()
  local data = parseGMNotesSafe(self.getGMNotes())
  local candidate = data[PACK_STATE_KEY]
  if PACK_SET_CONFIG[candidate] then
    return candidate
  end
  return nil
end

local function buildGMNotesForSet(setcode)
  local data = parseGMNotesSafe(self.getGMNotes())
  data[PACK_STATE_KEY] = setcode
  return JSON.encode(data)
end

local function writeSetcodeToGMNotes()
  self.setGMNotes(buildGMNotesForSet(current_setcode))
end

local function rebuildSelfForSet(setcode, player_color)
  local cfg = PACK_SET_CONFIG[setcode]
  if not cfg then return end

  local data = self.getData()
  data.Nickname = "Flip it to rip it"
  data.GMNotes = buildGMNotesForSet(setcode)
  if type(data.CustomMesh) == "table" then
    data.CustomMesh.DiffuseURL = cfg.image
  end

  local pos = self.getPosition()
  local rot = self.getRotation()
  local lock = self.getLock()
  local scale = self.getScale()

  spawnObjectData({
    data = data,
    position = pos,
    rotation = rot,
    callback_function = function(new_obj)
      new_obj.setLock(lock)
      new_obj.setScale(scale)
      if player_color then
        broadcastToColor("Booster set to " .. cfg.label, player_color, {0.6, 1, 0.6})
      end
    end
  })

  self.destruct()
end

local function setPackSet(new_setcode, player_color)
  if not PACK_SET_CONFIG[new_setcode] then return end
  current_setcode = new_setcode
  rebuildSelfForSet(new_setcode, player_color)
end

function onSave()
  return JSON.encode({ setcode = current_setcode })
end

function onLoad(saved_data)
  local gm_setcode = readSetcodeFromGMNotes()
  if gm_setcode then
    current_setcode = gm_setcode
  elseif saved_data and saved_data ~= "" then
    local ok, state = pcall(JSON.decode, saved_data)
    if ok and type(state) == "table" and PACK_SET_CONFIG[state.setcode] then
      current_setcode = state.setcode
    end
  end

  self.clearContextMenu()
  self.addContextMenuItem("Set to SFD", function(player_color) setPackSet("SFD", player_color) end)
  self.addContextMenuItem("Set to OGN", function(player_color) setPackSet("OGN", player_color) end)
  self.addContextMenuItem("Set to UNL", function(player_color) setPackSet("UNL", player_color) end)

  writeSetcodeToGMNotes()
  self.setName("Flip it to rip it")
end

function onObjectRotate(rotated_object, spin, flip, player_color, old_spin, old_flip)
  if flip ~= old_flip and rotated_object == self then
    Global.call("RipBoosterPack", { player_color = player_color, object = self, setcode = current_setcode })
  end
end

          function() Properties[k] = nil end

    if loaded_data.zones ~= nil then

  else

  --In the event that there are no menus registered, download the default menu.
  Wait.frames(function()
    buildZones()

      broadcastToAll("No menu module located. Spawning the default menu module.")

    end
  end
  ,
  2

	--WebRequest.get(URLS['XML'],self,"buildUI")

-- Saves core data on save triggers.
------------------------------------
function onSave()
  local data_to_save = {}
  data_to_save["cards"] = {}
  data_to_save["properties"] = {}
  data_to_save["zones"] = {}
  data_to_save["values"] = {}
  data_to_save["players"] = JSON.encode(Players)
  data_to_save["menus"] = {}

  for i,v in pairs(EncodedObjects) do
    --Removing Object reference before encoding.
    EncodedObjects[i].this = getObjectFromGUID(i)
    if EncodedObjects[i].this ~= nil then
      local tempThis = EncodedObjects[i].this
      EncodedObjects[i].this = ""
      data_to_save["cards"][i] = JSON.encode(EncodedObjects[i])
      EncodedObjects[i].this = tempThis
    end
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Zones) do
    if Zones[i].funcOwner ~= nil then
      local tempThis = Zones[i].funcOwner
      Zones[i].funcOwner = Zones[i].funcOwner.getGUID()
      data_to_save["zones"][i] = JSON.encode(Zones[i])
      Zones[i].funcOwner = tempThis
    end
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Properties) do
    --Removing Object reference before encoding.
    if Properties[i].funcOwner ~= nil then
      local tempThis = Properties[i].funcOwner
      Properties[i].funcOwner = Properties[i].funcOwner.getGUID()
      data_to_save["properties"][i] = JSON.encode(Properties[i])
      Properties[i].funcOwner = tempThis
    end
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Values) do
    local tempThis = Values[i].validate
    Values[i].validate = ''
    data_to_save["values"][i] = JSON.encode(Values[i])
    Values[i].validate = tempThis
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Menus) do
    if Menus[i].funcOwner ~= nil then
      local tempThis = Menus[i].funcOwner
      Menus[i].funcOwner = Menus[i].funcOwner.getGUID()
      data_to_save["menus"][i] = JSON.encode(Menus[i])
      Menus[i].funcOwner = tempThis
    end
  end
  saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
  return saved_data
end

-- Calls the version check for the encoder, and any modules
-- which support an update check.
function callVersionCheck()
  if CORE_VALUE.beta then
    WebRequest.get(URLS['ENCODER_BETA'],self,"versionCheck")
  else
    WebRequest.get(URLS['ENCODER'],self,"versionCheck")
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Properties) do
    u = v.funcOwner.getVar('UPDATE_URL')
    if u ~= nil then
      WebRequest.get(u,v.funcOwner,"updateModule")
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Menus) do
    u = v.funcOwner.getVar('UPDATE_URL')
    if u ~= nil then
      WebRequest.get(u,v.funcOwner,"updateModule")
    end
  end
end

--The callVersionCheck callback for the encoder webrequest.
function versionCheck(wr)
  wr = wr.text
  local ver = versionComp(string.match(wr,"version = '(.-)'"),version)
  if ''..ver ~= ''..version then
    if CORE_VALUE.beta == true then
      broadcastToAll("An update has been found for the beta branch. Reloading encoder.")
    else
      broadcastToAll("An update has been found for the main branch. Reloading encoder.")
    end
    self.script_code = wr
    self.reload()
  else
    broadcastToAll("No update found at this time. Carry on.")
  end
end
--Compares two version strings of "(/d*.+)*"
--Examples: 1, 1.2, 0.1111.2, 0.0.0.0.1, 192.168.0.1
function versionComp(a,b)
  --First does the pattern only contain ([0-9]+)%.?
  --Pattern for versioning ##.##.##.##
  va = {}
  vb = {}
  for f in string.gmatch(a,'([0-9]+)%.?') do
    table.insert(va,tonumber(f))
  end
  for f in string.gmatch(b,'([0-9]+)%.?') do
    table.insert(vb,tonumber(f))
  end
  for k = 1, #va >= #vb and #va or #vb do
    if (va[k] ~= nil and va[k] or 0) > (vb[k] ~= nil and vb[k] or 0) then
      return a
    elseif (va[k] ~= nil and va[k] or 0) < (vb[k] ~= nil and vb[k] or 0) then
      return b
    end
  end
  return b
end

-- NEW- Registers each players hands as a zone for the encoder to track.
-- This is used to more reliably hide/reveal card buttons as it transitions zones.
function buildZones()
  local hands = {}
  local color = nil
  for k,v in pairs(Hands.getHands()) do
    --Hand Color
    color = v.getValue()
    --How many hands of this color have shown up. Init to 0 if nil.
    if hands[color] == nil then
      hands[color] = 0
    end
    hands[color] = hands[color]+1
    --Zone id is hand color + hand count for that color.
    id = color.."_"..hands[color]
    Zones[v.guid] = {
        name = id,
        func_enter = 'hideCardDetails',
        func_leave = 'showCardDetails',
        funcOwner = self,
        color = color}
  end
end
--Spawns in the default menu module if no menu module exists.
function getMenuModule(wr)
  local wr = wr.text
  params = {}
  params.type = "PiecePack_Crowns"
  params.position = self.getPosition()+Vector(0,1,0)
  params.rotation = self.getRotation()
  params.scale = Vector(1,1,1)*(2/3)
  params.sound = false
  params.callback_function = function(obj)
      obj.setName('Menu Module')
      obj.script_code = wr
      obj.reload()
      Wait.condition(function() obj.call("registerModule",nil) end,function() return obj.spawning end)
    end
  spawnObject(params)
end

  tar= tar[1]
  if EncodedObjects[tar.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    buildButtons(tar,true)
  end
end
function showCardDetails(tar)
  tar = tar[1]
  if EncodedObjects[tar.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    buildButtons(tar,false)
  end
end

-- Event Triggers
function onObjectEnterZone(zone, obj)
  if Zones[zone.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    --log("Object has entered zone: "..Zones[zone.getGUID()].name)
    self.call(Zones[zone.getGUID()].func_enter,{obj})
  end
end
function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, obj)
  if Zones[zone.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    self.call(Zones[zone.getGUID()].func_leave,{obj})
  end
end
function onObjectLeaveContainer(ctr,obj)
  if EncodedObjects[obj.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    EncodedObjects[obj.getGUID()].this = getObjectFromGUID(obj.getGUID())
    if obj.use_hands == true then
      Wait.condition( function()
      Wait.condition(
        function() local hand = handCheck(obj) buildButtons(obj,hand) end,
        function() return obj == nil or obj.resting end
      ) end,
      function() return not obj.resting end)
    end
  end
end
function onObjectDestroyed(obj)
  if obj == self then
    for i,v in pairs(EncodedObjects) do
      EncodedObjects[i].this = getObjectFromGUID(i)
      v.this.clearButtons()
      v.this.setName(v.name)
      v.this.clearContextMenu()
    end
		for k,v in pairs(Player.getColors()) do
			if v ~= "Grey" then
				--UI.setAttribute(k.."MainMenu","active",false)
			end
		end
    for k,v in pairs(Zones) do
      o = getObjectFromGUID(k)
      if o ~= nil and o.type ~= "Hand" then
        o.destruct()
      end
    end
  end
end
function onObjectDropped(c,obj)
  local ver = versionComp(Global.getVar('Encoder').getVar('version'),version)
  if ver == version and mod_name == 'Encoder' or Global.getVar('Encoder') == nil then
    Global.setVar('Encoder',self)
  end
  if EncodedObjects[obj.getGUID()] ~= nil and EncodedObjects[obj.getGUID()].disable ~= true then
  if obj.use_hands == true then
    Wait.condition(
      function() if obj ~= nil then local hand = handCheck(obj) buildButtons(obj,hand) end end,
      function() return obj == nil or obj.resting end
    )
  end
  end
  if obj.getVar("pID") ~= nil then
    obj.call("registerModule")
  end
end
--Use a raycast to check if an object is resting in a hand or not.
--Currently has a problem with tables that have multiple points of
--  impact during a raycast.
function handCheck(obj)
  if obj ~= nil and obj.getLock() == false and obj.held_by_color == nil then
    for k,v in pairs(obj.getZones()) do
      if Zones[v.guid] ~= nil and v.type == "Hand" then
        --log("In hand: "..Zones[v.guid].name)
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end

-- If the encoder is deleted, make sure to cleanup.
function encodeObject(o)
  if o.getVar('noencode') == true then
    return false
  end
  if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()] == nil and o ~= self then
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()] = {
    this = o,
    oName = o.getName(),
    oDesc = o.getDescription(),
    values = {},
    encoded = {},
    menus = {},
    editing = nil,
    flip = 1,
    disable = false
    }
    buildButtons(o)
    -- buildContextMenu(o)
    return true
  end
  return false
end
--Encodes a given player color, preping them for use with the api.
function encodePlayer(c)
  if Players[c] == nil then
    Players[c] = {
      this = c,
      values = {},
      encoded = {},
      editing = nil,
      style = "basic",
      menus = {}
    }
    --updateXML(c)
    return true
  end
  return false
end
--Helper function for creating uniform button sizes.
function updateSize(text,font_size,max_len,x_just,y_just)
  local temp = ''..text
  local size = 0
  local depth = 0
  local old_i = 0
  local i = 0
  local fsize = font_size
  while old_i < #temp do
    i = string.find(temp,"\n",old_i)
    if i == nil then
      i = #temp
    end
    if i - old_i > size then
      size = i-old_i
    end
    old_i = i+1
    depth = depth+1
  end
  if size <= max_len then
    fsize = font_size
  else
    fsize = font_size*(max_len/size)
  end

  offset_x = x_just*(size/19+0.05)*-1--*(fsize/(150/86)))
  offset_y = 0--y_just*((depth/2*fsize)+8)
  barSize = size*((fsize/(150/83)))+20
  return barSize,fsize,offset_x,offset_y
end

--Creates the context menu option for flipping a card for registered objects.
function buildContextMenu(o)
  o.addContextMenuItem('Flip Menu',function(ply) flipMenu(o,0) end)
end

--Calls the menus/property modules createButtons funciton
--  when updating a given object.
function buildButtons(o,h)
  if h == nil then
    h = handCheck(o)
  end
  if o==nil then return end
  if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].disable ~= true then
    o.clearButtons()
    o.clearInputs()
    if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].editing == nil then
      for k,v in pairs(Menus) do
        if v.funcOwner ~= nil then
          if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].menus[k] == nil then
            EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].menus[k] = {open=false,pos=0}
          end
          if v.visible_in_hand == nil then
            v.visible_in_hand = 0
          end
          if h==true and v.visible_in_hand>=1 then
            v.funcOwner.call(v.activateFunc,{obj=o})
          elseif h~=true and v.visible_in_hand<=1 then
            v.funcOwner.call(v.activateFunc,{obj=o})
          end
        else
          --log(v.funcOwner,"Missing module for menu "..k,'missing_module')
        end
      end
      for k,v in pairs(EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded) do
        if v == true and Properties[k]~=nil and Properties[k].funcOwner~= nil then
          if Properties[k].visible_in_hand == nil then
            Properties[k].visible_in_hand = 0
          end
          if h==true and Properties[k].visible_in_hand>=1 then
            Properties[k].funcOwner.call("createButtons",{obj=o})
          elseif h~=true and Properties[k].visible_in_hand<=1 then
            Properties[k].funcOwner.call("createButtons",{obj=o})
          end
        end
      end
    else
      k = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].editing
      if Properties[k]~=nil and Properties[k].funcOwner~= nil then
        Properties[k].funcOwner.call("createButtons",{obj=o})
      end
      flip = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip
      temp = " X "
      barSize,fsize,offset_x,offset_y = updateSize(temp,90,90,0,0)
      ob = {
      label=temp, click_function='closeEditor', function_owner=self,
      position={(-1.1+offset_x)*flip,0.28*flip,(1.4+offset_y)}, height=100, width=barSize, font_size=fsize,
      rotation={0,0,90-90*flip}
      }
      for k,v in pairs(APIgetStyleTable()) do
        if ob[k] == nil then
          ob[k] = v
        end
      end
      o.createButton(ob)
    end
  end
end
--Safety button in the event that an api user does not add a
-- way to give back control of buttons to the encoder.
function closeEditor(o)
  if type(o) == 'String' then
    Players[o].editing = nil
  else
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].editing = nil
  end
  buildButtons(o)
end

--Disables encoding of a card.
function disableEncoding(o,p)
  EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].disable = true
  o.setName(EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].oName)
  local selection =Player[p].getSelectedObjects()
  if selection ~= nil then
    for k,v in pairs(selection) do
      if EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()] ~= nil and v ~= o then
        EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()].disable = true
        v.setName(EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()].oName)
        v.clearButtons()
        v.clearInputs()
        buildButtons(v)
      end
    end
  end
  o.clearButtons()
  o.clearInputs()
  buildButtons(o)
end
--Flips the menu for the front face to the backface and reverse.
function flipMenu(o,p)
  local flip = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip
  if flip ~= 1 then
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip = 1
		o.hide_when_face_down = true
  else
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip = -1
		o.hide_when_face_down = false
  end
  if type(p) == "string" then
    local selection =Player[p].getSelectedObjects()
    if selection ~= nil then
      for k,v in pairs(selection) do
        if EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()] ~= nil and v ~= o then
          flipMenu(v,0)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  buildButtons(o)
end
--Turn target property on or off, calling the relevant Module functions.
function toggleProperty(o,p)
  if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    local prop = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p]
    if prop == nil then
      EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p] = true
    else
      if prop ~= true then
        EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p] = true
      else
        EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p] = false
      end
    end
    for k,v in pairs(Properties[p].values) do
      if Values[v] ~= nil and EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].values[v] == nil then
        EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].values[v] = Values[v].default
      end
    end
    return EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p]
  elseif type(o) == 'String' and Players[o] ~= nil then
    local prop = Players[o].encoded[p]
    if prop == nil then
      Players[o].encoded[p] = true
    else
      if prop ~= true then
        Players[o].encoded[p] = true
      else
        Players[o].encoded[p] = false
      end
    end
    for k,v in pairs(Properties[p].values) do
      if Values[v] ~= nil and Players[o].values[v] == nil then
        Players[o].values[v] = Values[v].default
      end
    end
    return Players[o].encoded[p]
  end
end


-- Factories
function buildValueValidationFunction(p)
  v=Values[p]
  if v.validType ~= nil and v.validType ~= 'nil' then
    if string.find('stringnumberboolean',v.validType) then
      local vt = v.validType
      Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur)
        if type(val) == vt then return val else return cur end end
    elseif string.find(v.validType, 'pattern%b()') then
      local _,_,pat = string.find(v.validType,'pattern(%b())')
      if #pat > 2 then
        pat = string.sub(pat,2,-2)
        Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur)
        if string.find(val,pat) then return val else return cur end end
      end
    elseif string.find(v.validType, 'color') then
      Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur)
      if val == '' or val == nil or Player[val] ~= nil then return val else return cur end end
    end
  else

-- Tool Functions
function deepcopy(orig)
    local orig_type = type(orig)
    local copy
    if orig_type == 'table' then
        copy = {}
        for orig_key, orig_value in next, orig, nil do
            copy[deepcopy(orig_key)] = deepcopy(orig_value)
        end
        setmetatable(copy, deepcopy(getmetatable(orig)))
    else -- number, string, boolean, etc
        copy = orig
    end
    return copy
end

function garbageCollect()
  for k,v in pairs(EncodedObjects) do
    if v.this == nil then
      if getObjectFromGUID(k) == nil then
        EncodedObjects[k] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Properties) do
    if v.funcOwner == nil then
      Properties[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Zones) do
    if v.funcOwner == nil then
      Zones[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Menus) do
    if v.funcOwner == nil then
      Menus[k] = nil
    end
  end
end

pID = "πGlimpse"
version = 3.14159

function onload()
  self.createButton({
    click_function='registerModule', function_owner=self, label='[i]'..pID..'[/i]', tooltip='register '..pID,
    position={0,0.1,0}, rotation={0,0,0}, scale={0.5,1,0.5},
    height=250, width=700, font_size=150,  color={0.1,0.1,0.1,1}, font_color={1,1,1,1},
  })
  Wait.condition(registerModule,function() return Global.getVar('Encoder') ~= nil and true or false end)
end

function registerModule()
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  tableGUIDs = Global.getTable('data')
  if enc ~= nil then
		properties = {
      propID = pID,
      name = "Scry Module",
      values = {},
      funcOwner = self,
      tags="tool,table_tool",
      activateFunc ='toggleProp',
      visible=false,
      visible_in_hand=2
		}
		enc.call("APIregisterProperty",properties)
  end
end

function toggleProp(obj,ply)
  enc.call("APItoggleProperty",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
  enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
end

-- disable scry buttons when leaving hand 2
 function onObjectLeaveZone(zone,obj)
   if obj==nil then return end --wtf? how can this happen? but it does
   if obj.type~="Card" then return end
   enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
   if enc then
     Zones=enc.call("APIlistZones",{})
     encZone=Zones[zone.getGUID()]
     if encZone then
       isHand2=encZone.name:find('Hand 2')
       if isHand2 then
         -- using GMnotes as a scry-zone flag (in case the object is just passing through the scry zone)
         if obj.getGMNotes()=='scryEnter' then obj.setGMNotes('') end
         -- check that the object is encoded
         if not(enc.call("APIobjectExists",{obj=obj})) then return end
         -- if encoded and scry is enabled, disable it
         if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
           enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
         end
       end
     end
   end
 end

function onObjectDestroy(obj)
  pcall(function()
    if obj==nil then return end --wtf? how can this happen? but it does
    enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
    if obj.type~="Card" or enc==nil then return end
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
    end
  end)
end

-- disable scry if the card lands on the table (height < 2)
function onObjectDrop(ply,obj)
  if obj==nil then return end --wtf? how can this happen? but it does
  if obj.type~="Card" then return end
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc==nil then return end
  if not(enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID})) then return end

  local inHand2=false
  if obj==nil then return end
  for _,col in pairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
    local handObjs=Player[col].getHandObjects(2)
    for _,handObj in pairs(handObjs) do
      if obj==handObj then
        inHand2=true
      end
    end
  end
  if not inHand2 then
    enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
  end
end

function createButtons(t)
  card=t.obj
  if card==nil then return end

  local backpars={    -- background frame
    label='', tooltip='', click_function = 'null', function_owner = self,
    position = {0, 0, 0}, width = 500, height = 400, font_size = 250,
    scale = {1.25,1.25,1.25}, rotation = {0,0,180},
    color = {0.7,0.7,0.7}, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
  }
  local forgpars={    -- foreground button with label
    label='', tooltip='', click_function = 'null', function_owner = self,
    position = {0, 0, 0}, width = 500, height = 400, font_size = 250,
    scale = {1.2,1.2,1.2}, rotation = {0,0,0},
    color = {0.16,0.16,0.16}, font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1}, hover_color = {0.4,0.4,0.4}
  }

  local lab='▲'
  local tip='to top deck'
  local fun='move2TopLib'
  local pos={-0.4, 0.1, -3}
  forgpars.label=lab
  forgpars.tooltip=tip
  forgpars.click_function=fun
  forgpars.position=pos
  backpars.position=pos
  card.createButton(backpars)
  card.createButton(forgpars)

  local lab='▼'
  local tip='to bottom deck'
  local fun='move2BotLib'
  local pos={-0.4, 0.1, -2}
  forgpars.label=lab
  forgpars.tooltip=tip
  forgpars.click_function=fun
  forgpars.position=pos
  backpars.position=pos
  card.createButton(backpars)
  card.createButton(forgpars)

  local lab='☠'
  local tip='move to graveyard'
  local fun='move2Grav'
  local pos={-0.4, 0.1, 2}
  forgpars.label=lab
  forgpars.tooltip=tip
  forgpars.click_function=fun
  forgpars.position=pos
  backpars.position=pos
  card.createButton(backpars)
  card.createButton(forgpars)
end

function move2Lib(card, playerColor, alt)
  if not(alt) then
    move2TopLib(card,playerColor)
  else
    move2BotLib(card,playerColor)
  end
end

function move2TopLib(card, playerColor)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=card,propID=pID})
  local deck = Global.call("findPlayerDeckByNameRemote", { playerColor, "main" })
  local deckPos = deck.getPosition()
  local target = {x=deckPos.x, y=deckPos.y+3, z=deckPos.z}    -- above deck
  card.clearButtons()
  card.setHiddenFrom(allBut(playerColor))
  Wait.time(function() unhide(card) end, 0.2)
  local cardRot = card.getRotation()
  cardRot.z = 180
  card.setRotationSmooth(cardRot,false,true)
  Wait.time(function() handTrigger(card) card.setPositionSmooth(target,false,true) end, 0.2)
  Wait.time(function() checkMoveSuccess(card,target,playerColor) end, 0.5)

  selected = Player[playerColor].getSelectedObjects()
  for i,obj in ipairs(shuffleList(selected)) do
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      Wait.frames(function() move2TopLib(obj, playerColor) end,i)
    end
  end
  Player[playerColor].clearSelectedObjects()

end

function move2BotLib(card, playerColor)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=card,propID=pID})
  local deck = Global.call("findPlayerDeckByNameRemote", { playerColor, "main" })
  local deckPos = deck.getPosition()
  local target  = {x=deckPos.x, y=1.1, z=deckPos.z}
  card.clearButtons()
  card.setHiddenFrom(allBut(playerColor))
  Wait.time(function() unhide(card) end, 0.2)
  local cardRot = card.getRotation()
  cardRot.z = 180
  card.setRotationSmooth(cardRot,false,true)
  Wait.time(function() handTrigger(card) card.setPositionSmooth(target,false,true) end, 0.2)
  Wait.time(function() checkMoveSuccess(card,target,playerColor) end, 0.5)

  selected = Player[playerColor].getSelectedObjects()
  for i,obj in ipairs(shuffleList(selected)) do
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      Wait.frames(function() move2BotLib(obj, playerColor) end, i)
    end
  end
  Player[playerColor].clearSelectedObjects()
end

function move2Grav(card, playerColor)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=card,propID=pID})
  local gravPos = Global.call("findPlayerZoneByNameRemote", { playerColor, "graveyard" })
  local target  = {x=gravPos.x, y=3, z=gravPos.z}
  card.clearButtons()
  local cardRot = card.getRotation()
  cardRot.z = 0
  card.setRotationSmooth(cardRot,false,true)
  Wait.time(function() handTrigger(card) card.setPositionSmooth(target,false,true) end, 0.2)
  Wait.time(function() checkMoveSuccess(card,target,playerColor) end, 0.5)

  selected = Player[playerColor].getSelectedObjects()
  for i,obj in ipairs(shuffleList(selected)) do
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      Wait.frames(function() move2Grav(obj, playerColor) end, i)
    end
  end
  Player[playerColor].clearSelectedObjects()
end

function shuffleList(list)
  math.randomseed(os.time())
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
  return list
end

-- for hiding cards
function allBut(playerColor)
  local players = {}
  for key, color in pairs(Color.list) do
    if color ~= playerColor then
      table.insert(players,color)
    end
  end
  return players
end
function unhide(card,nframes)
  if card~=nil then
    card.setHiddenFrom({})
  end
end

-- when returning cards from the scry-zone, turn off hand-zone's pull briefly
function handTrigger(obj)
  if obj~=nil then
    obj.use_hands=false
    Wait.time(function() handOn(obj) end, 0.1)
  end
end
function handOn(obj)
  if obj~=nil then
    obj.use_hands=true
  end
end

-- check that the card made it to it's target, if not, teleport it
function checkMoveSuccess(card,targetPos,playerColor)
  if card==nil then return end   -- the card is gone, probably stacked into a deck already
  -- use hands orientation to determine which coordinate to use to check position
  -- currently only set up to work with hands rotated 0,90,180,270 degrees
  local handForw=Player[playerColor].getHandTransform(2).forward
  local posDiff = 0
  if math.abs(handForw.z)>0.5 then
    posDiff = math.abs(card.getPosition().z - targetPos.z)
  elseif math.abs(handForw.x)>0.5 then
    posDiff = math.abs(card.getPosition().x - targetPos.x)
  end
  if posDiff>1 then
    card.setPosition(targetPos)
  end
end

function GetStringWidth(str)
    local len = 0
    for i = 1, #str do
        local c = str:sub(i,i)
        len = len + (charWidth[c] or charWidth.avg)
    end
    return len

-- Get real string width as per char table
function findStringLength(str)
    local len = 0
    local k=0
    for i = 1, #str do
        local c = str:sub(i,i)
        len = len + (charWidth[c] or charWidth.avg)
    end

-- Over-engineered method to convert input string to button string
-- inserting line-breaks whenever the width of a line exceeds the box
maxWidth=59837    -- found by trial and error
maxNlines=9
function insertBreaks(str)

  -- first, split the str by any existing line-breaks
  local strTable={}
  local brInd=nil
  while str:find('\n') do
    brInd=str:find('\n')
    table.insert(strTable,str:sub(1,brInd))
    str=str:sub(brInd+1,-1)
  end
  table.insert(strTable,str)

  -- split each string further by maxWidth
  local strTable2={}
  local nLines = 0
  for _,str in ipairs(strTable) do

    str=str:gsub('[\n]','')    -- remove \n, it'll get reinserted with table.concat

    local len = 0
    local stInd = 1
    local enInd = nil
    local parsing = true
    local i=0

    while parsing do

      i=i+1
      local c = str:sub(i,i)
      if c==' ' then enInd=i end  -- save last encoutered space ind
      prevLen = len
      len = len + (charWidth[c] or charWidth.avg)

      if i>=#str and len<=maxWidth then   -- reached the end of string
        local snip=str:sub(stInd,i)
        table.insert(strTable2,snip)
        nLines=nLines+1
        parsing = false
        break
      end

      if len>maxWidth then   -- maxWidth reached
        if enInd then        -- a space was found
          local snip = str:sub(stInd,enInd-1)
          table.insert(strTable2,snip)
          nLines=nLines+1
          len=0
          stInd=enInd+1
          i=enInd
          enInd=nil
        else                 -- a long sequence of characters without space
          local snip = str:sub(stInd,i-1)
          table.insert(strTable2,snip)
          nLines=nLines+1
          len=0
          stInd=i
          i=i-1
          enInd=nil
        end

        if i>=#str then
          parsing = false
        end

      end

      if nLines>maxNlines then    -- max number of lines reached
        parsing=false
      end

    end
  end

  while nLines<maxNlines do       -- fill up the rest of the lines
    nLines=nLines+1
    table.insert(strTable2,' ')
  end

  return table.concat(strTable2,'\n')

end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This tool makes sure all players (present and future) are promoted so they have "host" powers: delete/spawn/copy/paste/etc.

The tool also takes care that deliberately demoted players are never automatically promoted again (such as if they drop & rejoin or if time is rewound).

You'll probably want to hide this underneath the table, disable tooltip, and disable interactivity (see script).
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--::[[ Auto Player Promoter ]]::--
-- Version 1.0
-- By Kevin O'Mara (Quickle)
-- https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197997376704

--[[
This script runs in the background and makes sure all players are promoted so
they have "host" powers (delete/spawn/copy/paste/etc.) For more info on host:
http://berserk-games.com/knowledgebase/player-roles/

Additionally, if a player gets "demoted", the script takes care they are never
automatically promoted again (i.e. when the player drops and re-joins the match,
the game is saved and loaded in the future, or time is rewound/fast forwarded).

Players are promoted at the following times:
* All players are promoted each time the game first loads (including Undo/Redo).
* New players are promoted upon joining the match.

Whether a player is "demoted" is recorded at the following times:
* All players are recorded when the game saves (including auto saves).
* Individual players are recorded when they leave the match.

Undo / Redo
* Undo - A demoted player may become promoted again if time rewinds to a point
  when they were previously promoted.
* Redo - A player will never become demoted when time fast forwards, even if
  they had previously been demoted at that autosave.
--]]



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[ CONFIGURATION  ]]----------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[
You can modify the script's behavior by changing these variables:
--]]

-- When true, this object is interactable by Players.
-- You may wish to lock this object and hide it somewhere. To do so, simply:
--  1. Set this value to 'true' & save the script.
--  2. Move the object somewhere & save the game.
--  3. Set this value back to 'false' & save the script.
local objectIsInteractable = true

-- When true, a chat message announces each time a player is automatically
-- promoted or would have been promoted (but wasn't because they are "demoted").
-- Lets players know they are being promoted by a script rather than the host.
local chatEnabled = false

-- When true, debug information is written the log window (host only).
local loggingEnabled = false


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[ SCRIPT CODE  ]]------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[ Utility Methods ]]---------------------------------------------------------

local function _log(element, label)
    -- Log a message with the prefix "AutoPlayerPromoter: ".
    -- Wrapper for `log()`: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/base/#log
    if loggingEnabled then
        log(element, "AutoPlayerPromoter: " .. tostring(label))
    end
end

local function _printToAll(message)
    -- Print a message to chat, but only if `chatEnabled` is `true`.
    -- Wrapper for `print()`: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/base/#print
    if chatEnabled then
        printToAll(message)
    end
end

local function _playerAsTable(player)
    -- Return a <Player> object (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/) as a
    -- simple key-value table, which can be expanded by the built-in logging
    -- method: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/base/#log
    return {
        steam_name  = player.steam_name,
        steam_id    = player.steam_id,
        promoted    = player.promoted,
        host        = player.host,
        admin       = player.admin,
        color       = player.color,
        team        = player.team,
        seated      = player.seated,
        blindfolded = player.blindfolded,
        lift_height = player.lift_height,
    }
end
--//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////



--[[ Player Promotion Tracker ]]------------------------------------------------
--[[
Keeps track of which players are demoted and offers a method to promote players.
--]]

-- Steam IDs of Players who have had their promotion revoked.
-- @type: Set<string>
local _demotedPlayerSteamIds = {}

function isOnDemotedPlayerList(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    return _demotedPlayerSteamIds[player.steam_id] ~= nil
end

function isPromoted(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    return player.promoted or player.host
end

function tryPromotePlayer(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    if isOnDemotedPlayerList(player) then
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Will not promote player because they are on the Demoted Player List: ")
        _printToAll("AutoPlayerPromoter: Not promoting player " .. tostring(player.steam_name) .. ", because they were demoted by host.")
    elseif isPromoted(player) then
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Will not promote player because they are already promoted or host: ")
    else
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Promoting player: ")
        _printToAll("AutoPlayerPromoter: Promoting " .. tostring(player.steam_name))
        player.promote()
    end
end

function savePlayerPromotionState(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    if isPromoted(player) then
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Saving player's promotion status. Player is <promoted>: ")
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds[player.steam_id] = nil
    else
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Saving player's promotion status. Player is <demoted>: ")
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds[player.steam_id] = {}
    end
end
--//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////



--[[ Event Hooks ]]-------------------------------------------------------------
--[[
Makes sure players are getting promoted and recorded at the right times by
responding to events.
--]]

function onLoad(saveData)
    self.interactable = objectIsInteractable

    _log(saveData, "Loading from script state: ")
    if saveData == "" then
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds = {}
    else
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds = JSON.decode(saveData)
    end

    local players = Player.getPlayers()
    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        tryPromotePlayer(player)
    end
end

function onPlayerConnect(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    tryPromotePlayer(player)
end

function onPlayerDisconnect(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    savePlayerPromotionState(player)
end

function onSave()
    local players = Player.getPlayers()
    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        savePlayerPromotionState(player)
    end

    saveData = JSON.encode(_demotedPlayerSteamIds)
    _log(saveData, "Saving script state: ")
    return saveData
end

--Suppressed
--By Tipsy Hobbit, adapted for GA by Amphi
pID = "GA_Suppress"
version = '1.12'

function onload()
  self.createButton({
  label="+", click_function='registerModule', function_owner=self,
  position={0,0.2,-0.5}, height=100, width=100, font_size=100,
  rotation={0,0,0},tooltip="Version: "..version
  })
  Wait.condition(registerModule,function() return Global.getVar('Encoder') ~= nil and true or false end)
end
function registerModule()
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc ~= nil then
		properties = {
		propID = pID,
		name = "Banished",
		values = {'ga_suppressed'},
		funcOwner = self,
		tags='tool,face_prop',
		activateFunc ='suppress'
		}
		enc.call("APIregisterProperty",properties)
    value = {
    valueID = 'ga_suppressed',
    validType = 'boolean',
    desc = 'GA: Is the card suppressed?.',
    default = false
    }
    enc.call("APIregisterValue",value)
  end
end
function createButtons(t)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc ~= nil then
    flip = enc.call("APIgetFlip",{obj=t.obj})
    scaler = {x=0.5,y=0.5,z=0.5}--t.obj.getScale()
    temp = "BANISHED\r\nclick to return"
    barSize,fsize,offset_x,offset_y = enc.call('APIformatButton',{str=temp,font_size=400,max_len=90,xJust=0,yJust=0})
    t.obj.createButton({
    label=temp, click_function='unsuppress', function_owner=self,
    position={(0+offset_x)*flip*scaler.x,0.63*flip*scaler.z,(0+offset_y)*scaler.y}, height=800, width=1300, font_size=200,color={0,0,0,1},font_color={0.3,0.8,0.3,1},
    rotation={0,90,90-90*flip,tooltip="This object is Suppressed."}
    })
  end
end
function suppress(obj,ply)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc ~= nil then
    enc.call("APItoggleProperty",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
    data = enc.call("APIobjGetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
		if data.ga_suppressed ~= true then
			data.ga_suppressed = true
    else
      data.ga_suppressed = false
    end
    enc.call("APIobjSetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID,data=data})
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
  end
  local ga_menu = Global.getVar('GA_Menu')
  ga_menu.call("shutMenu", {obj=obj})
end
function unsuppress(obj,ply)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc ~= nil and enc.call("APIobjectExists",{obj=obj}) then
    flip = enc.call("APIgetFlip",{obj=obj})

		data = enc.call("APIobjGetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
		if data.ga_suppressed == true then
			data.ga_suppressed = false
			enc.call("APIobjSetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID,data=data})
      enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
		end
		if type(ply) == "string" then
			local selection =Player[ply].getSelectedObjects()
			if selection ~= nil then
				for k,v in pairs(selection) do
					if v ~= tar and enc.call("APIobjectExists",{obj=v}) == true then
						unsuppress(v,0)
					end
				end
			end
		end
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
  end
end
function updateModule(wr)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc ~= nil then
    wr = wr.text
    wrv = string.match(wr,"version = '(.-)'")
    if wrv == 'DEPRECIATED' then
      enc.call("APIremoveProperty",{propID=pID})
      self.destruct()
    end
    local ver = enc.call("APIversionComp",{wv=wrv,cv=version})
    if ''..ver ~= ''..version then
      broadcastToAll("An update has been found for "..pID..". Reloading Module.")
      self.script_code = wr
      self.reload()
    else
      broadcastToAll("No update found for "..pID..". Carry on.")
    end
  end
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function getCorrectRotation()
  local sideOfTable = self.getPosition().z > 0
  return sideOfTable and {0,0,0} or {0,180,0}
end

function onDrop(color)
    self.setRotationSmooth(getCorrectRotation(), false, true)
end

function onLoad()
  -- ---------- Side drop-zone button ----------
  self.createButton({
      label          = "♻",
      click_function = "linkToDeckBottom",
      function_owner = Global,
      position       = {3, -0.35, 0},
      rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
      width          = 1400,
      height         = 1200,
      font_size      = 600,
      color          = {0.44, 0.66, 0.77, 1},
      font_color     = {0, 0, 0, 1},
      tooltip        = "Drop cards here to recycle",
  })
  Wait.frames(function() buildQuickActionUI() end, 10)
end

local function findById(node, wantId)
  if type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end

  local attrs = node.attributes
  if attrs and attrs.id == wantId then
    return node
  end

  local kids = node.children
  if kids then
    for _, child in ipairs(kids) do
      local found = findById(child, wantId)
      if found then return found end
    end
  end

  return nil
end

function buildQuickActionUI()
  local buttons = Global.getVar("QUICK_ACTION_BUTTONS")
  if type(buttons) ~= "table" then return end

  local alternatingColors = {
    "#88B8E8|#A8D8FF|#5088C8|#E8F8FF",
    "#70A8C4|#90C8E4|#4088A4|#D8F0FF",
  }
  local colorIndex = 1

  local buttonChildren = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(buttons) do
    local fn = entry.fn or entry.function_name
    local label = entry.label or entry.text
    if fn and label then
      if not tostring(fn):match("^Global/") then
        fn = "Global/" .. tostring(fn)
      end

      table.insert(buttonChildren, {
        tag = "Button",
        attributes = {
          colors = alternatingColors[colorIndex],
          fontStyle = "Bold",
          fontSize = "50",
          onClick = fn,
        },
        value = tostring(label),
      })

      colorIndex = 3 - colorIndex
    end
  end

  local xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local grid = findById(xml[1], "quick_action_grid")
  if not grid then
    print("[QuickActions] Could not find GridLayout id=quick_action_grid")
    return
  end

  grid.children = buttonChildren
  self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
end

function getCorrectRotation()
  local sideOfTable = self.getPosition().z > 0
  return sideOfTable and {0,0,0} or {0,180,0}
end

function onDrop(color)
    self.setRotationSmooth(getCorrectRotation(), false, true)
end

function onLoad()
  -- ---------- Side drop-zone button ----------
  self.createButton({
      label          = "♻",
      click_function = "linkToDeckBottom",
      function_owner = Global,
      position       = {3, -0.35, 0},
      rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
      width          = 1400,
      height         = 1200,
      font_size      = 600,
      color          = {0.44, 0.66, 0.77, 1},
      font_color     = {0, 0, 0, 1},
      tooltip        = "Drop cards here to recycle",
  })
  Wait.frames(function() buildQuickActionUI() end, 10)
end

local function findById(node, wantId)
  if type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end

  local attrs = node.attributes
  if attrs and attrs.id == wantId then
    return node
  end

  local kids = node.children
  if kids then
    for _, child in ipairs(kids) do
      local found = findById(child, wantId)
      if found then return found end
    end
  end

  return nil
end

function buildQuickActionUI()
  local buttons = Global.getVar("QUICK_ACTION_BUTTONS")
  if type(buttons) ~= "table" then return end

  local alternatingColors = {
    "#88B8E8|#A8D8FF|#5088C8|#E8F8FF",
    "#70A8C4|#90C8E4|#4088A4|#D8F0FF",
  }
  local colorIndex = 1

  local buttonChildren = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(buttons) do
    local fn = entry.fn or entry.function_name
    local label = entry.label or entry.text
    if fn and label then
      if not tostring(fn):match("^Global/") then
        fn = "Global/" .. tostring(fn)
      end

      table.insert(buttonChildren, {
        tag = "Button",
        attributes = {
          colors = alternatingColors[colorIndex],
          fontStyle = "Bold",
          fontSize = "50",
          onClick = fn,
        },
        value = tostring(label),
      })

      colorIndex = 3 - colorIndex
    end
  end

  local xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local grid = findById(xml[1], "quick_action_grid")
  if not grid then
    print("[QuickActions] Could not find GridLayout id=quick_action_grid")
    return
  end

  grid.children = buttonChildren
  self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
end

MAX_VALUE = 21

local val = 0
local color = ""

-- ---------- LOAD / SAVE ----------

function onLoad(saved_data)
    color = self.getName():match("^%S+") or ""

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local ok, data = pcall(JSON.decode, saved_data)
        if ok and data and data[1] then
            val = data[1]
        end
    end

    rebuildUI()
    createButtons()
end

function updateSave()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode({ val })
end

-- ---------- UI ----------

function rebuildUI()
    local fontColor = getFontColor(val)

    local xml = [[
    <Panel width="800" height="800" position="0 50 -60" rotation="180 180 0">
        <Text
            id="score"
            text="]] .. val .. [["
            fontSize="420"
            fontStyle="Bold"
            alignment="MiddleCenter"
            color="]] .. fontColor .. [["
        />
    </Panel>
    ]]

    self.UI.setXml(xml)
end

function getFontColor(v)
    if v == 5 then return "#FFFF00" end
    if v == 6 then return "#FFCC00" end
    if v == 7 then return "#FF8800" end
    if v == 8 then return "#00FF00" end
    return "#FFFFFF"
end

-- ---------- BUTTONS ----------

function createButtons()
    self.clearButtons()

    -- Single invisible button that handles both clicks
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onClick",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0.4, 0},
        width = 1400,
        height = 2200,
        color = {0,0,0,0},
        tooltip = self.getName()
    })
end

function onClick(_, player_color, alt_click)
    local delta = alt_click and -1 or 1
    setValue(val + delta, player_color)
end

-- ---------- LOGIC ----------

function setValue(newVal, player_color)
    newVal = math.max(MIN_VALUE, math.min(MAX_VALUE, newVal))
    if newVal == val then return end

    if val<newVal then broadcastToAll(color.." Player scores! ("..newVal.." points)", {1, 1, 0}) end
    if val>newVal then broadcastToAll(color.." Player loses a point! ("..newVal.." points)", {1, 1, 0}) end

    val = newVal
    rebuildUI()
    createButtons()    
    updateSave()

    Global.call("onAdjustScoreRemote", {
        player_color = player_color,
        new_score = val
    })
end

-- ---------- UTIL ----------

function reset_val()
    val = 0
    rebuildUI()
    createButtons()
    updateSave()
end

self.max_typed_number = 99
function onNumberTyped(_, int)
    setValue(int)
end
