ObjectStates.LuaScript:
prop_id = "riftbound-card-menu"
version = "1.0.0"

local encoder
do
	local mt = {
		__index = function(self, index)
			return function(args) return rawget(self, "object").call("API" .. index, args) end
		end
	}

	encoder = function()
		local object = Global.getVar("Encoder")
		return object ~= nil and setmetatable({ object = object }, mt) or nil
	end
end

local function register_module()
	local enc = encoder()
	if enc == nil then return end

	if tonumber(enc.object.getVar("version"):match("%d+%.%d+")) < 4.4 then
		broadcastToAll("encoder version must be >=4.4", { 1, 0, 0, 1 })
		error("bad encoder version")
	end

	enc.registerProperty {
		propID = prop_id,
		name = "Card Menu",
		values = { "riftbound_might", "riftbound_cards_equipped", "riftbound_equipped_spawns"  },
		tags = "basic,counter",
		visible = false,
		visible_in_hand = 0,

		funcOwner = self,
		activateFunc = "",
	}

	enc.registerValue {
		valueID = "riftbound_might",
		validType = "nil",
		desc = "",
		default = {},
	}

	enc.registerValue {
		valueID = "riftbound_cards_equipped",
		validType = "nil",
		desc = "",
		default = {},
	}

	enc.registerValue {
	    valueID = "riftbound_equipped_spawns",
	    validType = "nil",
	    desc = "Cached GMNotes.spawn of equipped cards",
	    default = {}
	}

end

buffZoneGuid = "2fad01"
function isObjectInBuffZone(obj)
		local isInBuffZone = false
		local isInChampionZone = false
    if not obj then return false end
    for _, z in ipairs(obj.getZones()) do
        if z.guid == buffZoneGuid then
            isInBuffZone = true
        end
				if z.getName() == "MaterialDeckZone" then
					isInChampionZone = true
				end
    end
    return isInBuffZone and not isInChampionZone
end

function init_card(card)
	if card.tag ~= "Card" or card.getName()=="Quick Actions Panel" then return end
	if card.getVar('noencode') ~= nil and card.getVar('noencode') == true then return end

	local gm_notes = parseGMNotes(card.getGMNotes())
	if not gm_notes["type"] or gm_notes["type"]=="rune" then return end

	local enc = encoder()
	if enc == nil then return end

	if not enc.objectExists { obj = card } then enc.encodeObject { obj = card } end

	if not enc.propertyExists { propID = prop_id } then return end

	if not enc.objIsPropEnabled { obj = card, propID = prop_id } then
		enc.objEnableProp { obj = card, propID = prop_id }
		enc.rebuildButtons { obj = card }
	end
end

equip_rows = 3

local function equipped_offset(i)
	local col = math.floor(i / equip_rows)
	local row = i % equip_rows
	return Vector(-1.85 - 1.35 * col, 0.07 + row * (-0.05 / equip_rows), -0.58 + row * (1.7 / equip_rows))
end

local function attachment_guid(attached)
	if attached and type(attached.getGUID) == "function" then
		return attached.getGUID()
	elseif type(attached) == "table" then
		return attached.guid
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalize_equipped_cards(host, data)
	data.riftbound_cards_equipped = data.riftbound_cards_equipped or {}
	local raw = data.riftbound_cards_equipped

	if type(raw.slot_count) == "number" and type(raw.slots) == "table" then
		return raw
	end

	local migrated = { slot_count = 0, slots = {} }
	if type(raw) == "table" and #raw > 0 and type(raw[1]) == "number" then
		local atts = host.getAttachments() or {}
		for i, idx in ipairs(raw) do
			local guid = attachment_guid(atts[idx])
			migrated.slot_count = i
			migrated.slots[i] = (type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "") and guid or false
		end
	elseif type(raw) == "table" then
		for i, guid in ipairs(raw) do
			migrated.slot_count = i
			migrated.slots[i] = (type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "") and guid or false
		end
	end

	data.riftbound_cards_equipped = migrated
	return migrated
end

local function slot_guid(slot_data, slot)
	if not slot_data or type(slot_data.slots) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local v = slot_data.slots[slot]
	return (type(v) == "string" and v ~= "") and v or nil
end

local function first_empty_slot(slot_data)
	local limit = math.max(slot_data.slot_count or 0, 0)
	for i = 1, limit do
		if not slot_guid(slot_data, i) then
			return i
		end
	end
	return limit + 1
end

local function count_occupied_slots(slot_data)
	local n = 0
	local limit = math.max(slot_data.slot_count or 0, 0)
	for i = 1, limit do
		if slot_guid(slot_data, i) then n = n + 1 end
	end
	return n
end

local function guid_to_attachment_index(host)
	local map = {}
	for i, attached in ipairs(host.getAttachments() or {}) do
		local guid = attachment_guid(attached)
		if type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "" then
			map[guid] = i
		end
	end
	return map
end

local MAX_EQUIP_SLOTS = 18

local function add_host_slot_unequip_buttons(host, slot_data)
	local max_slots = math.min(slot_data.slot_count or 0, MAX_EQUIP_SLOTS)
	for i = 1, max_slots do
		if slot_guid(slot_data, i) then
			local slot_pos = equipped_offset(i - 1)
		host.createButton({
			label = "X",
			position = {-(slot_pos.x + 0.55), 0.30, slot_pos.z - 0.20},
			scale = {0.40, 0.40, 0.40},
			width = 320,
			height = 320,
			color = {0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 1},
			font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
			font_size = 240,
			tooltip = "Unequip",
			click_function = "unequip_equipped_slot_" .. tostring(i),
			function_owner = self,
		})
		end
	end
end

function equip_to_overlapped_card(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    if not obj or obj.tag ~= "Card" then return end

		local card_scale = obj.getScale()[1]
		local equipped_card_scale = card_scale/1.618

    local enc = encoder()
    if enc == nil then return end

    -- Find overlapping cards beneath this equipment
    local hits = Physics.cast({
        origin       = obj.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.2, 0),
        direction    = {0, -1, 0},
        max_distance = 1.5,
        type         = 3, -- box
        size         = {2.5*card_scale, 0.2, 3*card_scale}, -- roughly card footprint
        debug        = false,
    })

    local candidates = {}

    for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
        local hitObj = hit.hit_object
				if hitObj and hitObj ~= obj and hitObj.tag == "Card" and not hitObj.is_face_down then
					local parsednotes = parseGMNotes(hitObj.getGMNotes())
	        if parsednotes.might then
	            table.insert(candidates, hitObj)
	        end
				end
    end

    if #candidates == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No valid card to equip to.", player_color, {1,0.4,0.4})
        return
    end

    -- Choose top-left-most card
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
        local pa = a.getPosition()
        local pb = b.getPosition()

        if math.abs(pa.x - pb.x) > 0.01 then
            return pa.x < pb.x
        end
        return pa.z > pb.z
    end)

    local target = candidates[1]

    -- Ensure encoder data exists
    if not enc.objectExists { obj = target } then
        enc.encodeObject { obj = target }
    end

    if not enc.objIsPropEnabled { obj = target, propID = prop_id } then
        enc.objEnableProp { obj = target, propID = prop_id }
    end

    local data = enc.objGetPropData { obj = target, propID = prop_id }
    local slot_data = normalize_equipped_cards(target, data)
		data.riftbound_might = data.riftbound_might or {}
		data.riftbound_equipped_spawns = data.riftbound_equipped_spawns or {}

		-- snapshot GMNotes of the gear
		if obj.getGMNotes() ~= "" then
				local parsednotes = parseGMNotes(obj.getGMNotes())
				if parsednotes.spawn then
					table.insert(data.riftbound_equipped_spawns, parsednotes.spawn)
				end
		end

    -- Position + attach
    local slot = first_empty_slot(slot_data)
    if slot > MAX_EQUIP_SLOTS then
        broadcastToColor("No equip slots available.", player_color, {1,0.4,0.4})
        return
    end
    local offsetIndex = slot - 1
    local angles = target.getRotation()

    obj.setPosition(target.positionToWorld(equipped_offset(offsetIndex)))
    obj.setRotation(angles, false, false)
    obj.setScale({equipped_card_scale,equipped_card_scale,equipped_card_scale})
    obj.locked = true

    target.addAttachment(obj)

    slot_data.slot_count = math.max(slot_data.slot_count or 0, slot)
    slot_data.slots[slot] = obj.getGUID()

    broadcastToColor(
        "Equipped to " .. (target.getName() or "card"),
        player_color,
        {0.6, 0.9, 1}
    )

		Global.call("onEquipGearRemote", { unit_object = target, gear_object = obj, player_color = player_color })

		local targetparsednotes={}
		if obj.getGMNotes() ~= "" then
			targetparsednotes = Global.call("parseGMNotes", target.getGMNotes())
			if targetparsednotes.might then
				data.riftbound_might.original_might = targetparsednotes.might
			end
		end

		local gearparsednotes={}
		if obj.getGMNotes() ~= "" then
			gearparsednotes = Global.call("parseGMNotes", obj.getGMNotes())
			if gearparsednotes.might_delta then
				data.riftbound_might.gear_might_delta = gearparsednotes.might_delta + (data.riftbound_might.gear_might_delta or 0)
			end
		end

		enc.objSetPropData { obj = target, propID = prop_id, data = data }
		enc.rebuildButtons { obj = target }
end

function imprint_to_overlapped_battlefield(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    if not obj then return end
    local hits = Physics.cast({
        origin       = obj.getPosition()+vector(0,3,0),
        direction    = {0, -1, 0},
        max_distance = 5,
        type         = 1, -- ray
    })

    local candidates = {}

    for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
        local hitObj = hit.hit_object
				local hitObjName = hitObj.getName()
        if hitObj
            and hitObj ~= obj
            and hitObj.tag == "Tile"
						and hitObjName
						and hitObjName:match("Battlefield")
        then
            table.insert(candidates, hitObj)
        end
    end

    if #candidates == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No battlefield to imprint on.", player_color, {1,0.4,0.4})
        return
    end

    -- Choose topmost (highest Y)
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
        return a.getPosition().y > b.getPosition().y
    end)

    local battlefield = candidates[1]

    -- Call imprint safely
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        battlefield.call("imprintRemote", { obj = obj, player_color = player_color })
    end)

    if not ok then
        broadcastToColor("Battlefield cannot be imprinted.", player_color, {1,0.4,0.4})
        print("[IMPRINT ERROR]", err)
        return
    end

		obj.setPositionSmooth(battlefield.getPosition()+vector(0,0.4,0), false, true)
		obj.setRotationSmooth(battlefield.getRotation()+vector(0,90,0), false, true)
		obj.alt_view_angle = {0, 180, -90}
    broadcastToColor(
        "Imprinted onto battlefield.",
        player_color,
        {0.6, 1, 0.6}
    )
end

local function unequip_single_equipped_slot(host, slot, player_color)
	local enc = encoder()
	if enc == nil or not host or host.tag ~= "Card" then return end

	local menu_properties = enc.objGetPropData { obj = host, propID = prop_id }
	local slot_data = normalize_equipped_cards(host, menu_properties)
	if slot < 1 or slot > (slot_data.slot_count or 0) then return end

	local gear_guid = slot_guid(slot_data, slot)
	if not gear_guid then return end
	local att_index = guid_to_attachment_index(host)[gear_guid]
	if not att_index then
		slot_data.slots[slot] = false
		enc.objSetPropData {
			obj = host,
			propID = prop_id,
			data = {
				riftbound_might = menu_properties.riftbound_might or {},
				riftbound_cards_equipped = slot_data,
				riftbound_equipped_spawns = menu_properties.riftbound_equipped_spawns or {},
			}
		}
		enc.rebuildButtons { obj = host }
		return
	end

	local released = host.removeAttachment(att_index - 1)
	if not released then return end
	slot_data.slots[slot] = false

	local parsednotes = parseGMNotes(released.getGMNotes())
	if parsednotes.spawn and menu_properties.riftbound_equipped_spawns then
		for j = #menu_properties.riftbound_equipped_spawns, 1, -1 do
			if menu_properties.riftbound_equipped_spawns[j] == parsednotes.spawn then
				table.remove(menu_properties.riftbound_equipped_spawns, j)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if parsednotes.might_delta and menu_properties.riftbound_might then
		menu_properties.riftbound_might.gear_might_delta =
			(menu_properties.riftbound_might.gear_might_delta or 0) - parsednotes.might_delta
	end

	local i = slot
	local unequip_offset = Vector(-1.6 + i * -0.55, 0.1 + i * 0.6, -1 + i * 0.45)
	released.setPositionSmooth(host.positionToWorld(unequip_offset), false, true)
	released.setScale(host.getScale())
	released.setRotation(host.getRotation())
	released.setVelocity({0,0,0})
	released.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})
	released.locked = false

	enc.objSetPropData {
		obj = host,
		propID = prop_id,
		data = {
			riftbound_might = menu_properties.riftbound_might or {},
			riftbound_cards_equipped = slot_data,
			riftbound_equipped_spawns = menu_properties.riftbound_equipped_spawns or {},
		}
	}
	enc.rebuildButtons { obj = host }
end

for i = 1, MAX_EQUIP_SLOTS do
	_G["unequip_equipped_slot_" .. tostring(i)] = function(host, player_color, alt_click)
		unequip_single_equipped_slot(host, i, player_color)
	end
end

function unequip_all(obj, player_color)
	local enc = encoder()
	if enc == nil then return end

	local menu_properties = enc.objGetPropData { obj = obj, propID = prop_id }
	local slot_data = normalize_equipped_cards(obj, menu_properties)
	if count_occupied_slots(slot_data) == 0 then return end

	for i = (slot_data.slot_count or 0), 1, -1 do
			local guid = slot_guid(slot_data, i)
			if guid then
				local idx = guid_to_attachment_index(obj)[guid]
				local new = idx and obj.removeAttachment(idx - 1) or nil
				if new then
			local unequip_offset = Vector(-1.6+ i*-0.55, 0.1 + i*0.6, -1 + i* 0.45)
			new.setPositionSmooth(obj.positionToWorld(unequip_offset), false, true)
	    new.setScale(obj.getScale())
			new.setRotation( obj.getRotation() )
			new.setVelocity({0,0,0})
			new.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})
			new.locked = false
				end
			end
	end

	local might_data = menu_properties.riftbound_might or {}
	might_data["gear_might_delta"] = 0
	enc.objSetPropData {
		obj = obj,
		propID = prop_id,
		data = {
			riftbound_might = might_data,
			riftbound_cards_equipped = { slot_count = 0, slots = {} },
			riftbound_equipped_spawns = {}
		}
	}
	enc.rebuildButtons { obj = obj }
end

function spawn_token_from_unit(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    if not obj or obj.tag ~= "Card" then return end

    local spawn_name = getSpawnNotes(obj)
    if not spawn_name then return end

    local new_token = spawn_token(obj, spawn_name, player_color, alt_click)
end

function spawn_token(obj, spawn_name, player_color, alt_click)
		if not obj or obj.tag ~= "Card" then return end
    if not spawn_name or spawn_name == "" then return end

    local i = 0
    for name in string.gmatch(spawn_name, "([^;]+)") do
        name = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if name ~= "" then
            local new = Global.call("spawnFromNameFragmentRemote", {
                nameFragment = name,
                player_color = player_color
            })

						if new then
                -- HARD STOP: prevent instant deck merge
                new.locked = true
                new.setVelocity({0,0,0})
                new.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})

                -- spawn in local space, slightly elevated
                local localOffset = Vector(
                    -2 - 1 * i,
                    1.2,            -- IMPORTANT: high enough to avoid deck snap
                    0.3 * i
                )

                new.setPositionSmooth(obj.positionToWorld(localOffset), false, true)
                new.setRotation(obj.getRotation(), false, true)


                -- finalize next frame
                Wait.frames(function()
                    if not new or new.tag ~= "Card" then return end
                    new.locked = false
                    init_card(new)
                end, 2)

                i = i + 1
            end
        end
    end
end

local function cleanupCardLeavingPlay(card)
    if not card or card.tag ~= "Card" or card.getName() == "flourish" then return end


    local enc = encoder()
    if not enc then return end
    if not enc.objectExists { obj = card } then return end
    if not enc.objIsPropEnabled { obj = card, propID = prop_id } then return end

    local data = enc.objGetPropData { obj = card, propID = prop_id } or {}

    if data.riftbound_might then
        data.riftbound_might.temp_might_delta = 0
        data.riftbound_might.gear_might_delta = 0
    end

    enc.objSetPropData {
        obj = card,
        propID = prop_id,
        data = data
    }

		unequip_all(card, nil)

    card.UI.setXml("") -- clear UI overlay
    enc.rebuildButtons { obj = card }
end

function onObjectDropped(ply, obj)
	init_card(obj)
	local enc = encoder()
	if not enc or not obj or obj.tag ~= "Card" then return end
	if not enc.objectExists { obj = obj } then return end
	if not enc.objIsPropEnabled { obj = obj, propID = prop_id } then return end

	-- Rebuild immediately and for a short burst while the card is still in motion,
	-- so equip/load buttons appear during the fall instead of after settling.
	enc.rebuildButtons { obj = obj }
	for f = 1, 20 do
		Wait.frames(function()
			if obj and enc.objectExists { obj = obj } and enc.objIsPropEnabled { obj = obj, propID = prop_id } then
				enc.rebuildButtons { obj = obj }
			end
		end, f)
	end
end

ObjectStates.Description: Encode and Decode riftbound decks in LUA
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Riftbound Deck Code library (Format 1, Version 3) for Tabletop Simulator
-- Mirrors: https://github.com/Piltover-Archive/RiftboundDeckCodes

local bit = bit32 or bit
if not bit then
    error("bit32 library not found; TTS Lua requires bit32 for deckcode decoding")
end
local bit32 = bit

local M = {}

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BASE32 (RFC 4648)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local BASE32_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567"
local BASE32_INV = {}
for i = 1, #BASE32_ALPHABET do
    BASE32_INV[string.byte(BASE32_ALPHABET, i)] = i - 1
end

-- Streaming Base32 decode (RFC 4648)
local function base32Decode(str)
    local out = {}
    local buffer = 0
    local bitsLeft = 0

    str = str:gsub("%s+", "")
    str = str:gsub("=+$", "")

    for i = 1, #str do
        local v = BASE32_INV[string.byte(str, i)]
        if v == nil then
            return nil
        end

        buffer = bit.bor(bit.lshift(buffer, 5), v)
        bitsLeft = bitsLeft + 5

        while bitsLeft >= 8 do
            bitsLeft = bitsLeft - 8
            local byte = bit.band(bit.rshift(buffer, bitsLeft), 0xFF)
            out[#out + 1] = byte
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function base32Encode(bytes)
    local out = {}
    local buffer = 0
    local bitsLeft = 0

    for i = 1, #bytes do
        buffer = bit.bor(bit.lshift(buffer, 8), bytes[i])
        bitsLeft = bitsLeft + 8

        while bitsLeft >= 5 do
            bitsLeft = bitsLeft - 5
            local index = bit.band(bit.rshift(buffer, bitsLeft), 0x1F)
            out[#out + 1] = string.sub(BASE32_ALPHABET, index + 1, index + 1)
        end
    end

    if bitsLeft > 0 then
        buffer = bit.lshift(buffer, 5 - bitsLeft)
        local index = bit.band(buffer, 0x1F)
        out[#out + 1] = string.sub(BASE32_ALPHABET, index + 1, index + 1)
    end

    return table.concat(out)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- VARINT (DECODE/ENCODE)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function readVarint(bytes, pos)
    local result = 0
    local shift = 0
    local startPos = pos.pos

    while true do
        if pos.pos > #bytes then
            error("Unexpected EOF while reading varint at pos " .. startPos)
        end

        local b = bytes[pos.pos]
        pos.pos = pos.pos + 1

        result = result + bit32.lshift(bit32.band(b, 0x7F), shift)

        if bit32.band(b, 0x80) == 0 then
            return result, startPos, pos.pos - 1
        end

        shift = shift + 7
        if shift > 35 then
            error("Varint too large / corrupted at pos " .. startPos)
        end
    end
end

local function writeVarint(value)
    if value == 0 then
        return { 0 }
    end

    local out = {}
    while value ~= 0 do
        local byteVal = bit.band(value, 0x7F)
        value = bit.rshift(value, 7)

        if value ~= 0 then
            byteVal = bit.bor(byteVal, 0x80)
        end

        out[#out + 1] = byteVal
    end

    return out
end

local function appendBytes(dst, src)
    for i = 1, #src do
        dst[#dst + 1] = src[i]
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SET + VARIANT MAPPINGS (must be filled using your data)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local SET_MAP = rawget(_G, "SET_MAP") or {
    OGN = 0,
    OGS = 1,
    ARC = 2,
    SFD = 3,
    UNL = 4,
    VEN = 5,
    RAD = 6,
}
_G.SET_MAP = SET_MAP

local VARIANT_MAP = rawget(_G, "VARIANT_MAP") or {
    [""] = 0,
    a = 1,
    s = 2,
    ["*"] = 2,
    b = 3,
}
_G.VARIANT_MAP = VARIANT_MAP

-- Reverse lookup maps
local SET_MAP_REV = {}
for k, v in pairs(SET_MAP) do
    SET_MAP_REV[v] = k
end

local VARIANT_MAP_REV = {}
for k, v in pairs(VARIANT_MAP) do
    VARIANT_MAP_REV[v] = k
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CARD CODE HELPERS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function parseCardCode(cardCode)
    local set, rest = cardCode:match("^([^%-]+)%-(.+)$")
    if not set or not rest then
        error("Invalid card code format: " .. tostring(cardCode))
    end

    local number, variant = rest:match("^(%d+)([a-z%*]?)$")
    if not number then
        error("Invalid card code format: " .. tostring(cardCode))
    end

    return set, number, variant or ""
end

local function groupBySetAndVariant(cards)
    local groups = {}
    local list = {}

    for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
        local set, number, variant = parseCardCode(card.cardCode)

        local setValue = SET_MAP[set]
        if setValue == nil then
            error("Unknown set: " .. tostring(set))
        end

        local variantValue = VARIANT_MAP[variant]
        if variantValue == nil then
            error("Unknown variant: " .. tostring(variant))
        end

        local key = tostring(setValue) .. ":" .. tostring(variantValue)
        local group = groups[key]
        if not group then
            group = {
                set = setValue,
                variant = variantValue,
                cardNumbers = {},
            }
            groups[key] = group
            list[#list + 1] = group
        end

        group.cardNumbers[#group.cardNumbers + 1] = number
    end

    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        if a.set ~= b.set then
            return a.set < b.set
        end
        return a.variant < b.variant
    end)

    for _, group in ipairs(list) do
        table.sort(group.cardNumbers, function(a, b)
            return tonumber(a) < tonumber(b)
        end)
    end

    return list
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DECODE A SECTION (main deck or sideboard)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function decodeDeckSection(bytes, pos, maxCount, signedSuffix)
    local results = {}
    signedSuffix = signedSuffix or "s"

    for count = maxCount, 1, -1 do
        local numGroups, err = readVarint(bytes, pos)
        if not numGroups then
            error(err)
        end

        for _ = 1, numGroups do
            local numCards, err = readVarint(bytes, pos)
            if not numCards then
                error(err)
            end

            -- set and variant are RAW BYTES (not varints)
            if pos.pos + 1 > #bytes then
                error("Unexpected EOF reading set/variant")
            end

            local setValue = bytes[pos.pos]
            pos.pos = pos.pos + 1

            local varValue = bytes[pos.pos]
            pos.pos = pos.pos + 1

            local setCode = SET_MAP_REV[setValue]
            local variantCode = nil

            if not setCode then
                error("Unknown set code: " .. tostring(setValue))
            end

            if varValue == 2 then
                variantCode = signedSuffix
            else
                variantCode = VARIANT_MAP_REV[varValue]
            end

            for i = 1, numCards do
                local cardNumber, err = readVarint(bytes, pos)
                if not cardNumber then
                    error(err)
                end

                table.insert(results, {
                    cardCode = string.format(
                        "%s-%03d%s",
                        setCode,
                        cardNumber,
                        variantCode or ""
                    ),
                    count = count
                })
            end
        end
    end

    return results
end

local function decodeChosenChampion(bytes, pos, signedSuffix)
    signedSuffix = signedSuffix or "s"

    -- Read presence flag (exactly 1 byte)
    if pos.pos > #bytes then
        return nil
    end

    local hasChampion = bytes[pos.pos]
    pos.pos = pos.pos + 1

    if hasChampion ~= 0x01 then
        -- 0x00 -> no chosen champion
        return nil
    end

    -- Next: set (1 byte), variant (1 byte)
    if pos.pos + 1 > #bytes then
        error("Unexpected EOF reading chosen champion set/variant")
    end

    local setValue = bytes[pos.pos]
    local varValue = bytes[pos.pos + 1]
    pos.pos = pos.pos + 2

    local setCode = SET_MAP_REV[setValue]
    if not setCode then
        error("Unknown set code in chosen champion: " .. tostring(setValue))
    end

    local variantCode = nil
    if varValue == 2 then
        variantCode = signedSuffix
    else
        variantCode = VARIANT_MAP_REV[varValue]
    end

    -- Finally: card number (varint)
    local cardNumber, err = readVarint(bytes, pos)
    if not cardNumber then
        error(err)
    end

    return string.format(
        "%s-%03d%s",
        setCode,
        cardNumber,
        variantCode or ""
    )
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ENCODE A SECTION (main deck or sideboard)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function encodeDeckSection(deck, maxCount)
    local bytes = {}

    for count = maxCount, 1, -1 do
        local matching = {}
        for _, card in ipairs(deck) do
            if card.count == count then
                matching[#matching + 1] = card
            end
        end

        local groups = groupBySetAndVariant(matching)
        appendBytes(bytes, writeVarint(#groups))

        for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
            appendBytes(bytes, writeVarint(#group.cardNumbers))
            bytes[#bytes + 1] = group.set
            bytes[#bytes + 1] = group.variant

            for _, cardNumber in ipairs(group.cardNumbers) do
                appendBytes(bytes, writeVarint(tonumber(cardNumber)))
            end
        end
    end

    return bytes
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PUBLIC API
---------------------------------------------------------------------
function M.decode(code, options)
    local rawBytes = base32Decode(code)
    if not rawBytes then
        return nil
    end

    local pos = { pos = 1 }
    local signedSuffix = (options and options.signedSuffix) or "s"

    -- Header
    local FV = rawBytes[pos.pos]
    pos.pos = pos.pos + 1

    local format = bit32.band(bit32.rshift(FV, 4), 0x0F)
    local version = bit32.band(FV, 0x0F)

    if format ~= 1 then
        error("Unsupported format: " .. format)
    end

    -- Main deck
    local main = decodeDeckSection(rawBytes, pos, 12, signedSuffix)

    -- Sideboard
    local side = {}
    if version >= 2 then
        side = decodeDeckSection(rawBytes, pos, 3, signedSuffix)
    end

    -- Chosen champion (version 3+)
    local chosenChampion = nil
    if version >= 3 then
        chosenChampion = decodeChosenChampion(rawBytes, pos, signedSuffix)
    end

    return {
        mainDeck = main,
        sideDeck = side,
        chosenChampion = chosenChampion,
        format = format,
        version = version,
    }
end

function M.encode(mainDeck, sideDeck, chosenChampion)
    local bytes = {}

    -- Always emit format 1, version 3 for parity with TS
    bytes[#bytes + 1] = bit.bor(bit.lshift(1, 4), 3)

    appendBytes(bytes, encodeDeckSection(mainDeck or {}, 12))
    appendBytes(bytes, encodeDeckSection(sideDeck or {}, 3))

    if chosenChampion then
        local set, number, variant = parseCardCode(chosenChampion)
        local setValue = SET_MAP[set]
        if setValue == nil then
            error("Unknown set in chosen champion: " .. tostring(set))
        end

        local variantValue = VARIANT_MAP[variant]
        if variantValue == nil then
            error("Unknown variant in chosen champion: " .. tostring(variant))
        end

        bytes[#bytes + 1] = 0x01
        bytes[#bytes + 1] = setValue
        bytes[#bytes + 1] = variantValue
        appendBytes(bytes, writeVarint(tonumber(number)))
    else
        bytes[#bytes + 1] = 0x00
    end

    return base32Encode(bytes)
end

function decode_json(params)
  local code = params.code
  local decoded = M.decode(code)
  return JSON.encode(decoded)
end

function onLoad(saved_data)
  Global.setVar('Riftbound_DeckCodes', self)
end

function getCorrectRotation()
  local sideOfTable = self.getPosition().z > 0
  return sideOfTable and {0,0,0} or {0,180,0}
end

function onDrop(color)
    self.setRotationSmooth(getCorrectRotation(), false, true)
end

function onLoad()
  -- ---------- Side drop-zone button ----------
  self.createButton({
      label          = "♻",
      click_function = "linkToDeckBottom",
      function_owner = Global,
      position       = {3, -0.35, 0},
      rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
      width          = 1400,
      height         = 1200,
      font_size      = 600,
      color          = {0.44, 0.66, 0.77, 1},
      font_color     = {0, 0, 0, 1},
      tooltip        = "Drop cards here to recycle",
  })
  Wait.frames(function() buildQuickActionUI() end, 10)
end

local function findById(node, wantId)
  if type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end

  local attrs = node.attributes
  if attrs and attrs.id == wantId then
    return node
  end

  local kids = node.children
  if kids then
    for _, child in ipairs(kids) do
      local found = findById(child, wantId)
      if found then return found end
    end
  end

  return nil
end

function buildQuickActionUI()
  local buttons = Global.getVar("QUICK_ACTION_BUTTONS")
  if type(buttons) ~= "table" then return end

  local alternatingColors = {
    "#88B8E8|#A8D8FF|#5088C8|#E8F8FF",
    "#70A8C4|#90C8E4|#4088A4|#D8F0FF",
  }
  local colorIndex = 1

  local buttonChildren = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(buttons) do
    local fn = entry.fn or entry.function_name
    local label = entry.label or entry.text
    if fn and label then
      if not tostring(fn):match("^Global/") then
        fn = "Global/" .. tostring(fn)
      end

      table.insert(buttonChildren, {
        tag = "Button",
        attributes = {
          colors = alternatingColors[colorIndex],
          fontStyle = "Bold",
          fontSize = "50",
          onClick = fn,
        },
        value = tostring(label),
      })

      colorIndex = 3 - colorIndex
    end
  end

  local xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local grid = findById(xml[1], "quick_action_grid")
  if not grid then
    print("[QuickActions] Could not find GridLayout id=quick_action_grid")
    return
  end

  grid.children = buttonChildren
  self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
end
